senses.en: not working correctly because something is wrong
containing mistakes or based on incorrect reasoning

ex.en: The electrician replaced the faulty switch in our kitchen.
ex.zh: 电工更换了我们厨房里那个有故障的开关。

ex.en: Policies based on faulty assumptions may fail to address the underlying causes of urban poverty.
ex.zh: 基于错误假设的政策可能无法解决城市贫困的根本原因。

tip: 既可形容设备故障，也可形容推理有误。

senses.en: Wood collected or cut for burning as fuel.

ex.en: We stacked dry firewood beside the stove before dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭前，我们把干柴堆在了炉子旁边。

ex.en: In some rural communities, dependence on firewood for cooking can contribute to deforestation and indoor air pollution.
ex.zh: 在一些农村社区，依赖柴火做饭可能加剧森林砍伐和室内空气污染。

tip: 不可数名词；一块木柴可说a piece of firewood。

senses.en: An action continuing or checking earlier work or treatment.
Done after something to continue it or check its results.

ex.en: The clinic arranged a follow-up to check my recovery.
ex.zh: 诊所安排了一次复诊，以检查我的恢复情况。

ex.en: A follow-up study is needed to determine whether the training programme produces lasting improvements in employment outcomes.
ex.zh: 需要开展后续研究，以确定该培训项目是否能持续改善就业结果。

tip: 名词、形容词带连字符；动词短语follow up不带。

senses.en: To order someone not to do something or disallow it

ex.en: Our building rules forbid leaving bicycles in the hallway.
ex.zh: 我们楼的规定禁止将自行车停放在走廊里。

ex.en: Governments should forbid companies from releasing untreated waste into rivers to protect public health and aquatic ecosystems.
ex.zh: 政府应禁止企业将未经处理的废弃物排入河流，以保护公众健康和水生生态系统。

tip: 过去式forbade，过去分词forbidden；可接动名词。

senses.en: The finger next to the thumb.

ex.en: She pressed the doorbell gently with her forefinger.
ex.zh: 她用食指轻轻按了门铃。

ex.en: Participants used their forefinger to press a button whenever they noticed a change on the screen.
ex.zh: 参与者每当注意到屏幕上出现变化时，就用食指按下按钮。

tip: 与index finger同义，都是紧挨拇指的食指。

senses.en: in the past, but not now

ex.en: This bright café was formerly a small bicycle shop.
ex.zh: 这家明亮的咖啡馆以前是一家小自行车店。

ex.en: Buildings formerly used for manufacturing can be converted into affordable housing while preserving their distinctive architectural features.
ex.zh: 以前用于制造业的建筑可以改建成经济适用住房，同时保留其独特的建筑特色。

tip: formerly指“以前”；formally指“正式地”。

senses.en: a small part or amount of something
a mathematical quantity representing part of a whole

ex.en: This jacket costs a fraction of the original price.
ex.zh: 这件夹克的售价只是原价的一小部分。

ex.en: Only a small fraction of household waste is recycled in some rapidly growing cities.
ex.zh: 在一些快速发展的城市，只有少量生活垃圾得到回收利用。

tip: a fraction of常强调占比极小，不只是一般部分。

senses.en: A small piece broken off or separated from something larger.
To break something, or become broken, into smaller separate parts.

ex.en: I found a fragment of blue glass beside the gate.
ex.zh: 我在大门旁发现了一块蓝色玻璃碎片。

ex.en: Plastic waste can fragment into tiny particles that enter food chains and threaten marine wildlife.
ex.zh: 塑料垃圾会碎裂成微小颗粒，进入食物链并威胁海洋野生动物。

tip: 名词重音在前；动词读/fræɡˈment/，重音在后。

senses.en: A pleasant smell, especially from flowers or perfume.
A liquid or substance used to give a pleasant smell.

ex.en: The fragrance of fresh roses filled the small kitchen.
ex.zh: 鲜玫瑰的香气弥漫在小厨房里。

ex.en: Some consumers prefer products without added fragrance because scented ingredients can irritate sensitive skin.
ex.zh: 一些消费者偏爱不添加香料的产品，因为芳香成分可能刺激敏感肌肤。

tip: fragrance通常指好闻的气味；smell则可褒可贬。

senses.en: Dishonest behaviour intended to gain money or another advantage.
A person or thing pretending to be genuine.

ex.en: The bank called after spotting possible fraud on my account.
ex.zh: 银行发现我的账户可能涉及诈骗后打来了电话。

ex.en: Stronger consumer protection laws can help prevent online fraud and increase public confidence in digital payments.
ex.zh: 更完善的消费者保护法律有助于防止网络诈骗，并增强公众对数字支付的信心。

tip: 欺诈行为通常不可数；指骗子时用a fraud。

senses.en: to do what a duty, promise, or agreement requires
to provide what is needed or meet a requirement
to achieve something hoped for or develop an ability fully

ex.en: She fulfilled her promise and repaired my bicycle.
ex.zh: 她履行了承诺，修好了我的自行车。

ex.en: Public libraries fulfil an important social role by providing free access to information and learning resources.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆通过免费提供信息和学习资源，发挥着重要的社会作用。

tip: 英式fulfil，美式fulfill；过去式均为fulfilled。

senses.en: The activity of collecting money for an organization or cause.

ex.en: Our fund-raising dinner helped buy books for the library.
ex.zh: 我们的筹款晚宴为图书馆购书提供了帮助。

ex.en: Community fund-raising can support local services, but essential healthcare should not depend entirely on charitable donations.
ex.zh: 社区筹款可以支持当地公共服务，但基本医疗不应完全依赖慈善捐赠。

tip: 也常拼作fundraising；raise funds意为筹款。

senses.en: put furniture into a room or building
provide someone with something needed, especially information

ex.en: We furnished our flat with second-hand tables and chairs.
ex.zh: 我们用二手桌椅布置了公寓。

ex.en: Applicants must furnish the university with evidence of their qualifications before their applications can be assessed.
ex.zh: 申请人必须向大学提供学历或资格证明，学校才能评估其申请。

tip: furnish A with B指向A提供B；提供义较正式。

senses.en: In addition, introducing another point supporting what was said

ex.en: The flat is spacious; furthermore, it has a balcony.
ex.zh: 这套公寓很宽敞，而且还有一个阳台。

ex.en: Public transport reduces traffic congestion; furthermore, it can make cities more accessible to residents without cars.
ex.zh: 公共交通能缓解交通拥堵，此外还能让没有汽车的居民更方便地在城市中出行。

tip: 正式递进副词；连接完整句时，前面用句号或分号。

senses.en: An extremely strong feeling of anger.
Extreme force or violence, especially in weather.

ex.en: He shook with fury when he discovered the damage.
ex.zh: 发现东西遭到损坏时，他气得浑身发抖。

ex.en: The sudden closure of the local hospital provoked fury among residents who depended on its services.
ex.zh: 当地医院突然关闭，激起了依赖其服务的居民的强烈愤怒。

tip: 比anger语气强；in a fury表示“勃然大怒”。

senses.en: Someone who risks money on uncertain outcomes
Someone willing to take risks for possible rewards

ex.en: The gambler left the table after losing his money.
ex.zh: 那个赌徒输掉钱后离开了赌桌。

ex.en: Support services can help a problem gambler regain financial stability and rebuild relationships with family members.
ex.zh: 支持服务可以帮助有赌博问题的人恢复财务稳定，并重建与家人的关系。

tip: gamble是赌博或冒险；gambler指从事这种行为的人。

senses.en: A group of people involved in crime or violence.
A group of friends or people working together.

ex.en: Our whole gang meets at the park on Saturdays.
ex.zh: 我们这群伙伴每周六都在公园碰面。

ex.en: Community programmes can reduce gang membership by offering young people educational support and meaningful employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 社区项目可以通过提供教育支持和有意义的就业机会，减少青少年加入帮派的现象。

tip: 指朋友群体时较口语化；正式语境常指犯罪团伙。

senses.en: Images or designs used on screens or in printed materials.

ex.en: The game's colourful graphics looked amazing on our new screen.
ex.zh: 这款游戏色彩鲜艳的画面在我们的新屏幕上看起来棒极了。

ex.en: Clear graphics can make complex scientific information easier to understand for audiences without specialist knowledge.
ex.zh: 清晰的图示能让没有专业知识的受众更容易理解复杂的科学信息。

tip: 指多个图像时用复数谓语：the graphics are。

senses.en: to eat growing grass, or let animals feed on it
to scrape skin slightly or touch something while passing
a small injury where skin has been scraped off

ex.en: Sheep graze quietly beside the river every summer morning.
ex.zh: 每个夏日清晨，羊群都在河边安静地吃草。

ex.en: Allowing cattle to graze too intensively can damage vegetation and increase the risk of soil erosion.
ex.zh: 让牛群过度放牧会破坏植被，并增加水土流失的风险。

tip: 动物吃草可说graze on grass；graze cattle指放牛。

senses.en: To a large degree or by a large amount.

ex.en: Your clear directions greatly helped us find the cottage.
ex.zh: 你清楚的指路说明帮了大忙，让我们找到了那间小屋。

ex.en: Access to affordable childcare can greatly improve parents' ability to remain in employment and pursue further education.
ex.zh: 获得负担得起的托育服务，可以大大提升父母继续工作和接受进一步教育的能力。

tip: 常修饰动词，如greatly improve；不说greatly good。

senses.en: a strong desire for more than one needs or deserves

ex.en: His greed left everyone else without any cake.
ex.zh: 他太贪吃，其他人连一点蛋糕也没分到。

ex.en: Corporate greed can undermine environmental protection when companies prioritise short-term profits over the welfare of local communities.
ex.zh: 当企业将短期利润置于当地社区福祉之上时，企业的贪婪就可能破坏环境保护。

tip: 不可数名词；greed for后接金钱、权力等渴求对象。

senses.en: wanting more money or possessions than one needs
wanting to eat more food than one needs

ex.en: Don't be greedy; leave some biscuits for your sister.
ex.zh: 别贪吃，给你妹妹留些饼干。

ex.en: Greedy investors may prioritise immediate profits over the long-term environmental consequences of their business decisions.
ex.zh: 贪婪的投资者可能优先考虑眼前利润，而忽视商业决策的长期环境后果。

tip: 常含贬义；greedy for后接金钱、权力等所贪之物。

senses.en: a glass or plastic building that keeps growing plants warm

ex.en: We grow tomatoes in the greenhouse throughout the winter.
ex.zh: 整个冬天，我们都在温室里种番茄。

ex.en: Greenhouse cultivation can extend growing seasons, although heating these structures may require considerable amounts of energy.
ex.zh: 温室种植可以延长生长季，但为这些设施供暖可能需要消耗大量能源。

tip: greenhouse是名词，也可作定语，如greenhouse gases。

senses.en: Someone legally responsible for a child or an adult needing care.
A person or organization that protects something valuable.

ex.en: Her aunt became her legal guardian and cared for her.
ex.zh: 她的姨妈成为她的法定监护人，照顾她的生活。

ex.en: Schools should involve parents or guardians in decisions that significantly affect children's education and emotional wellbeing.
ex.zh: 学校应让家长或监护人参与对儿童教育和心理健康有重大影响的决策。

tip: 法律语境中指监护人，不一定是孩子的父母。

senses.en: A large area of sea partly surrounded by land.
A major difference separating people, groups, or ideas.

ex.en: Fishing boats crossed the gulf as the sun rose.
ex.zh: 太阳升起时，渔船驶过海湾。

ex.en: Unequal access to digital technology can widen the gulf between wealthy communities and poorer ones.
ex.zh: 数字技术获取机会不平等可能扩大富裕社区与贫困社区之间的差距。

col: the gulf between rich and poor
tip: gulf可指海湾，也常用gulf between表示巨大差距。

senses.en: A thin bent pin used to hold hair in place.
A very sharp bend where a road nearly doubles back.

ex.en: She secured her bun with a silver hairpin.
ex.zh: 她用一枚银色发夹固定住发髻。

ex.en: Mountain roads with frequent hairpin bends require careful design to reduce accident risks and protect surrounding habitats.
ex.zh: 急转弯频繁的山路需要精心设计，以降低事故风险并保护周边栖息地。

tip: hairpin bend指形似发夹、几乎折返的急弯。

senses.en: A book giving practical information or instructions about a subject

ex.en: I checked the gardening handbook before pruning the rose.
ex.zh: 修剪玫瑰之前，我查阅了园艺手册。

ex.en: A comprehensive employee handbook helps new staff understand workplace procedures and reduces confusion about their responsibilities.
ex.zh: 一本全面的员工手册有助于新员工了解工作流程，减少他们对自身职责的困惑。

tip: 指便于查阅的实用指南，不是普通课本。

senses.en: How strongly a material resists scratching, cutting, or denting.
The amount of dissolved calcium and magnesium in water.

ex.en: The hardness of this wood makes it difficult to carve.
ex.zh: 这种木材硬度高，很难雕刻。

ex.en: Engineers assess the hardness of different materials before selecting suitable components for bridges and other major structures.
ex.zh: 工程师在为桥梁等大型结构选择合适的构件前，会评估不同材料的硬度。

tip: hardness 指硬度；hardship 才指困苦。

senses.en: A pile of things placed together without careful arrangement.
To put things together in a large pile.

ex.en: He left his clothes in a heap beside the bed.
ex.zh: 他把衣服乱堆在床边。

ex.en: Large heaps of discarded clothing highlight the environmental consequences of rapid consumption in the fashion industry.
ex.zh: 成堆的废弃衣物凸显了时尚行业快速消费带来的环境后果。

tip: a heap of 指一堆；heaps of 口语中表示大量。

senses.en: A small mammal with spines that curls into a ball.

ex.en: A hedgehog shuffled through the leaves beside our fence.
ex.zh: 一只刺猬在我们围栏旁的落叶间缓缓爬行。

ex.en: Leaving small gaps beneath garden fences allows hedgehogs to move safely between feeding areas.
ex.zh: 在花园围栏下留出小缝隙，可以让刺猬在觅食区域之间安全通行。

tip: hedgehog是刺猬；porcupine是豪猪，两者不是同一种动物。

senses.en: the main female character in a story
a woman admired for courage or remarkable achievements

ex.en: The heroine of this novel sails across the ocean.
ex.zh: 这部小说的女主角驾船横渡大洋。

ex.en: A confident heroine in children's literature can challenge stereotypes and broaden young readers' expectations.
ex.zh: 儿童文学中自信的女主角能够挑战刻板印象，拓宽小读者对未来的期待。

tip: 与heroin（海洛因）同音，注意末尾的e。

senses.en: A structure where a colony of bees lives.
A place full of busy people and activity.

ex.en: The beekeeper lifted the lid and inspected the hive.
ex.zh: 养蜂人掀开盖子，检查了蜂箱。

ex.en: Each community garden became a hive of activity as residents worked together to grow fresh vegetables.
ex.zh: 居民们共同种植新鲜蔬菜，使每个社区菜园都成为一派忙碌的场所。

tip: a hive of activity形容人们忙碌活动的场所。

senses.en: A delay that prevents something from continuing as planned
A robbery involving threats with a weapon

ex.en: A hold-up on the bridge made us miss lunch.
ex.zh: 桥上的堵塞让我们错过了午饭。

ex.en: Even a brief hold-up in the supply chain can significantly increase costs for small manufacturers.
ex.zh: 供应链中即使出现短暂延误，也可能显著增加小型制造商的成本。

tip: 名词有连字符；动词短语写作hold up。

senses.en: A stay in a local family's home while visiting another place

ex.en: During my homestay, I cooked dinner with the family.
ex.zh: 寄宿期间，我和寄宿家庭一起做晚饭。

ex.en: A homestay can help international students practise everyday language skills and understand local customs.
ex.zh: 在当地家庭寄宿可以帮助国际学生练习日常语言技能并了解当地习俗。

tip: 强调住进当地家庭；接待家庭常称host family。

senses.en: Great respect, or something that brings pride and privilege.
To show deep respect or publicly recognize someone's achievements.
To do what a promise or agreement requires.

ex.en: It was an honour to represent my local team.
ex.zh: 能代表本地球队出场，我感到很荣幸。

ex.en: Companies must honour their commitments to workers if they hope to maintain trust and reduce staff turnover.
ex.zh: 企业若想维持信任并减少员工流失，就必须履行对员工的承诺。

tip: 英式honour，美式honor；h不发音，用an。

senses.en: Flat or level, running parallel to the ground

ex.en: Keep the shelf horizontal while I tighten the screws.
ex.zh: 我拧紧螺丝时，请让架板保持水平。

ex.en: The horizontal axis shows time, allowing readers to compare changes in employment across the period.
ex.zh: 横轴表示时间，方便读者比较该时期内的就业变化。

tip: horizontal是水平的，vertical是垂直的。

senses.en: someone held captive to force others to meet demands

ex.en: The hostage returned home safely and hugged her family.
ex.zh: 那名人质平安回家，拥抱了家人。

ex.en: Governments must balance public safety with the need to secure the release of every hostage.
ex.zh: 政府必须兼顾公众安全与确保每一名人质获释的需要。

tip: take或hold someone hostage中，hostage前不加冠词。

senses.en: unfriendly or strongly opposed to someone or something
having conditions that make life or progress difficult
belonging to an enemy or acting against another side

ex.en: His hostile reply made everyone at the table uncomfortable.
ex.zh: 他充满敌意的回答让桌边的每个人都感到不自在。

ex.en: Communities may become hostile to new developments if residents feel excluded from the planning process.
ex.zh: 如果居民觉得自己被排除在规划过程之外，社区可能会强烈反对新的开发项目。

tip: hostile to后接名词或动名词，表示敌视或反对。

senses.en: A boat designed or adapted for people to live in.

ex.en: We spent the weekend on a houseboat beside the riverbank.
ex.zh: 我们在河岸边的一艘船屋上度过了周末。

ex.en: Living on a houseboat may offer affordable accommodation, although maintenance costs and mooring fees can be substantial.
ex.zh: 住在船屋上或许能降低居住开支，但维护成本和停泊费可能相当高。

tip: 指供人居住的船，不等于用于娱乐的游艇。

senses.en: the lightest chemical element, a colourless gas that burns easily

ex.en: Our science teacher showed us how hydrogen burns.
ex.zh: 科学老师向我们演示了氢气如何燃烧。

ex.en: Hydrogen produced using renewable electricity could help reduce emissions from industries that currently depend on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 利用可再生电力生产的氢气，可帮助目前依赖化石燃料的行业减少排放。

tip: hydrogen是不可数名词，表示化学元素氢或氢气。

senses.en: Not being used or doing any work.
Avoiding work or spending time doing nothing.
For an engine to run while the vehicle remains still.

ex.en: The sewing machine has sat idle since last winter.
ex.zh: 这台缝纫机从去年冬天起就一直闲置着。

ex.en: Leaving delivery vehicles idling outside schools contributes to air pollution and exposes children to unnecessary health risks.
ex.zh: 让送货车辆在学校外空转会加重空气污染，使儿童面临不必要的健康风险。

tip: idle可指人闲着、设备闲置，也可指发动机空转。

senses.en: annoyance caused by waiting, delays, or other people's behaviour
a strong desire for something to happen soon

ex.en: She tapped her foot with impatience as the queue stalled.
ex.zh: 队伍停滞不前，她不耐烦地用脚轻敲地面。

ex.en: Growing impatience with unreliable public transport may encourage commuters to use private cars, increasing urban congestion.
ex.zh: 人们对不可靠的公共交通日益不耐烦，可能促使通勤者转而使用私家车，加剧城市拥堵。

tip: 通常不可数；对某人或事不耐烦常接with。

senses.en: Having faults or lacking something needed to be complete.

ex.en: This handmade bowl is imperfect, but I love its shape.
ex.zh: 这个手工碗虽不完美，但我很喜欢它的形状。

ex.en: Although the current recycling system is imperfect, it still reduces the amount of waste sent to landfill.
ex.zh: 尽管现有的回收体系并不完善，它仍然减少了送往填埋场的垃圾量。

tip: 表示有缺陷，不等于完全无用或失败。

senses.en: A person, company, or country buying goods from abroad.

ex.en: The importer showed us coffee beans from several countries.
ex.zh: 那位进口商向我们展示了来自多个国家的咖啡豆。

ex.en: A country that becomes a major food importer may face greater exposure to international price fluctuations.
ex.zh: 一个成为主要粮食进口国的国家可能更容易受到国际价格波动的影响。

col: 主要进口商；主要进口国
tip: 既可指进口商，也可指进口商品的国家。

senses.en: the state of being impossible, or something that cannot happen

ex.en: Carrying this sofa upstairs alone is an impossibility.
ex.zh: 独自把这张沙发搬上楼是不可能的。

ex.en: The impossibility of predicting every natural disaster highlights the importance of resilient infrastructure and emergency planning.
ex.zh: 无法预测每一次自然灾害，这凸显了韧性基础设施和应急规划的重要性。

col: 客观条件下不可能的事
tip: 指不可能性时不可数；指一件不可能的事时可数。

senses.en: Unlikely to work well or be useful in practice
Not skilled at handling everyday practical tasks

ex.en: These white shoes are impractical for a muddy walk.
ex.zh: 穿这双白鞋走泥泞的路不太实用。

ex.en: Building underground railways may be impractical in smaller cities because construction costs often exceed available budgets.
ex.zh: 在较小的城市修建地铁可能不可行，因为建设成本往往超过可用预算。

tip: 是形容词，不是动词；不实用不一定是不可能。

senses.en: To put someone in prison or keep them confined.

ex.en: The judge imprisoned the thief for stealing valuable paintings.
ex.zh: 法官判处那名偷窃名贵画作的小偷入狱。

ex.en: Governments should consider whether imprisoning people for minor offences is more effective than providing supervised community service.
ex.zh: 政府应考虑，对轻微违法者实行监禁是否比安排受监督的社区服务更有效。

tip: be imprisoned for后可接罪名，也可接监禁时长。

senses.en: happening or available inside a physical shop
inside a physical shop rather than online

ex.en: The shop is offering free in-store cooking demonstrations today.
ex.zh: 这家店今天提供免费的店内烹饪演示。

ex.en: Despite the growth of online shopping, in-store services remain important for customers who need personalised advice.
ex.zh: 尽管网购不断发展，店内服务对于需要个性化建议的顾客仍然重要。

tip: in-store指店内的；“有库存”通常说in stock。

senses.en: not completely correct or exact

ex.en: The map was inaccurate, so we missed the turning.
ex.zh: 地图不准确，所以我们错过了转弯处。

ex.en: Inaccurate information online can undermine public trust and lead people to make poorly informed decisions.
ex.zh: 网上的不准确信息可能削弱公众信任，并导致人们在缺乏可靠信息的情况下作出决定。

tip: 指信息或测量不准确；不一定意味着故意造假。

senses.en: not enough or not good enough for a particular purpose
feeling unable to handle a situation successfully

ex.en: This tiny heater is inadequate for such a large room.
ex.zh: 这么大的房间用这个小暖气，供暖远远不够。

ex.en: Inadequate public transport can prevent rural residents from accessing employment opportunities and essential healthcare services.
ex.zh: 公共交通不足会妨碍农村居民获得就业机会和必要的医疗服务。

tip: 常用inadequate for；指数量不足或质量不达标。

senses.en: Used to introduce an additional or loosely related remark
As a secondary result, rather than the main purpose

ex.en: Incidentally, your scarf is still hanging by our door.
ex.zh: 顺便说一句，你的围巾还挂在我们家门边。

ex.en: Children may learn new vocabulary incidentally while watching educational programmes, even when language learning is not their main goal.
ex.zh: 孩子们看教育节目时，即使主要目的不是学习语言，也可能附带学到新词汇。

tip: 句首常表示“顺便说”；不等于所有语境中的偶然。

senses.en: not producing the result that is wanted

ex.en: This tiny fan is ineffective in such a large room.
ex.zh: 这个小风扇在这么大的房间里起不了作用。

ex.en: Awareness campaigns may be ineffective unless governments also provide affordable alternatives to environmentally harmful products.
ex.zh: 如果政府不同时提供价格可负担的环保替代品，宣传活动可能难以奏效。

tip: ineffective指无效果；inefficient指效率低。

senses.en: in a way that cannot be prevented or avoided

ex.en: Without regular watering, these flowers will inevitably die.
ex.zh: 如果不定期浇水，这些花必然会枯死。

ex.en: A growing population will inevitably increase demand for housing unless household sizes change significantly.
ex.zh: 除非家庭规模发生显著变化，否则人口增长必然会增加住房需求。

tip: 语气比probably强，表示结果无法避免。

senses.en: to cause a person or organism to develop an infection
to spread a feeling or attitude to others

ex.en: One sick rabbit can infect the others in its cage.
ex.zh: 一只生病的兔子可能传染同笼的其他兔子。

ex.en: Viruses can infect vulnerable patients more easily when hospitals lack effective hygiene measures and adequate ventilation.
ex.zh: 如果医院缺乏有效的卫生措施和充分的通风，病毒就更容易感染身体脆弱的患者。

tip: 常用infect someone with a virus，表示使某人感染病毒。

senses.en: Lower in quality, value, or ability than something else.
Having a lower rank or position.
Someone with a lower rank or position than another person.

ex.en: The cheaper bag felt inferior to the leather one.
ex.zh: 那个便宜包摸起来不如皮包好。

ex.en: Schools in disadvantaged areas should not receive inferior equipment simply because local funding is limited.
ex.zh: 弱势地区的学校不应仅因当地资金有限就获得较差的设备。

tip: 比较用inferior to，不用than；feel inferior指自卑。

senses.en: Having no end or limit
Extremely great in amount or degree

ex.en: My grandmother seems to have infinite patience with children.
ex.zh: 我奶奶对孩子似乎有无尽的耐心。

ex.en: Economic policies should not assume that the planet provides an infinite supply of natural resources.
ex.zh: 经济政策不应假定地球能提供无限的自然资源。

tip: 通常作形容词；表示“无穷”常用名词infinity。

senses.en: To live in a particular place or environment

ex.en: Tiny crabs inhabit the rock pools near our house.
ex.zh: 我们家附近的岩石潮池里栖息着小螃蟹。

ex.en: Many species that inhabit tropical forests face increasing pressure as agricultural expansion reduces the area of suitable habitat.
ex.zh: 随着农业扩张使适宜栖息地缩小，许多栖息在热带森林中的物种面临越来越大的压力。

tip: 及物动词，直接接地点，不加in。

senses.en: A person or animal that lives in a particular place.

ex.en: Every inhabitant of the village helped repair the bridge.
ex.zh: 村里的每一位居民都帮忙修了桥。

ex.en: Rapid urban growth can place pressure on housing and reduce access to green spaces for local inhabitants.
ex.zh: 城市快速扩张可能增加住房压力，并减少当地居民享用绿地的机会。

tip: 常用inhabitants of＋地点；不等于具有公民身份的citizens。

senses.en: Receive money or property from someone who has died
Receive physical characteristics genetically from your parents
Receive responsibilities or problems left by a previous person

ex.en: Leila inherited a small cottage from her grandmother.
ex.zh: 莱拉从祖母那里继承了一间小屋。

ex.en: Future generations may inherit serious environmental problems unless governments take decisive action to reduce pollution.
ex.zh: 除非各国政府采取果断措施减少污染，否则后代可能要接手严重的环境问题。

tip: 常用inherit sth from sb；遗传特征也可用。

senses.en: Located away from the coast, towards the country's interior
Away from the coast, towards or within the interior

ex.en: We stayed in a quiet inland village surrounded by hills.
ex.zh: 我们住在一个群山环绕的宁静内陆村庄。

ex.en: As coastal flooding becomes more frequent, some communities may move inland to reduce their exposure to risk.
ex.zh: 随着沿海洪灾日益频繁，一些社区可能迁往内陆，以降低面临的风险。

tip: 与coastal相对；作副词时也常重读第二音节。

senses.en: a process of investigating facts or seeking knowledge
a request for information about something

ex.en: My inquiry about the missing parcel received a quick reply.
ex.zh: 我询问了丢失包裹的情况，很快就收到了回复。

ex.en: An independent inquiry into river pollution revealed serious weaknesses in the current system of environmental monitoring.
ex.zh: 一项针对河流污染的独立调查揭示了现行环境监测体系的严重缺陷。

tip: 调查某事用inquiry into；英式enquiry也常指咨询。

senses.en: the process of putting equipment or software in place for use
equipment or buildings arranged for a particular purpose
an artwork made by arranging objects within a space

ex.en: Installation of our new dishwasher took less than an hour.
ex.zh: 我们的新洗碗机不到一小时就装好了。

ex.en: The installation of solar panels on public buildings can lower energy costs and reduce carbon emissions.
ex.zh: 在公共建筑上安装太阳能电池板可以降低能源成本并减少碳排放。

tip: 表示安装过程通常不可数；具体设施或作品可数。

senses.en: not enough for a particular need or purpose

ex.en: We had insufficient paint to finish the kitchen walls.
ex.zh: 我们的油漆不够，无法刷完厨房的墙。

ex.en: Insufficient funding prevents many rural schools from providing students with reliable internet access and modern learning materials.
ex.zh: 资金不足使许多乡村学校无法为学生提供可靠的网络连接和现代学习资料。

tip: 较正式；常用insufficient for或insufficient to do。

senses.en: Arrange financial protection against loss, damage, illness, or injury.

ex.en: We insured our bicycles before taking them abroad.
ex.zh: 我们带自行车出国前，先给它们买了保险。

ex.en: Small businesses should insure their premises against fire to avoid potentially devastating financial losses.
ex.zh: 小企业应为经营场所投保火险，以避免可能造成毁灭性打击的经济损失。

tip: insure主要指投保；表示确保通常用ensure。

senses.en: Relating to thinking, reasoning, and understanding complex ideas
Someone who studies and discusses complex ideas seriously

ex.en: She enjoys the intellectual challenge of learning a new language.
ex.zh: 她喜欢学习新语言带来的智力挑战。

ex.en: Schools should support intellectual development through activities that encourage students to question assumptions and evaluate evidence.
ex.zh: 学校应通过鼓励学生质疑假设、评估证据的活动来促进智力发展。

tip: intellectual强调思维活动；intelligent强调聪明。

senses.en: Requiring no interest payments on borrowed money.

ex.en: We bought our sofa with an interest-free loan.
ex.zh: 我们用一笔免息贷款买了沙发。

ex.en: Interest-free loans can help students cover living expenses without increasing their financial burden through interest charges.
ex.zh: 免息贷款可以帮助学生支付生活开支，而不会因利息费用增加他们的经济负担。

tip: 免息不等于免费：本金仍须偿还。

senses.en: a system through which users or devices interact
a boundary or connection between two things
connect and work together with another system or group

ex.en: The app's simple interface makes booking tickets much easier.
ex.zh: 这款应用的简洁界面让订票方便多了。

ex.en: An accessible user interface enables people with limited technical experience to benefit from digital public services.
ex.zh: 易于使用的用户界面能让技术经验有限的人也享受到数字公共服务。

tip: 计算机语境常指界面；作动词常接with。

senses.en: unwanted involvement in someone else's affairs or decisions
an action or influence that disrupts an activity or process
unwanted signals that reduce the quality of electronic reception

ex.en: I wanted to choose my clothes without anyone's interference.
ex.zh: 我想自己挑选衣服，不受任何人干涉。

ex.en: Universities need protection from political interference to ensure that research findings remain independent and credible.
ex.zh: 大学需要免受政治干预，以确保研究成果保持独立和可信。

tip: in多接事务指干涉；with多接活动指妨碍。

senses.en: a person or force entering a place without permission
an organism spreading into an area and threatening native life

ex.en: The castle walls once protected villagers from invaders.
ex.zh: 这些城堡围墙曾保护村民免遭入侵者袭击。

ex.en: Biological invaders can disrupt local ecosystems by competing with native species for food, space, and other resources.
ex.zh: 生物入侵者会与本地物种争夺食物、空间及其他资源，从而扰乱当地生态系统。

tip: invader指入侵者；invasion指入侵这一行为。

senses.en: not legally or officially acceptable
not supported by sound reasoning or reliable evidence

ex.en: My ticket was invalid, so I bought another one.
ex.zh: 我的票无效，所以我又买了一张。

ex.en: Conclusions drawn from a small, unrepresentative sample may be invalid and should not guide major policy decisions.
ex.zh: 从缺乏代表性的小样本中得出的结论可能不成立，不应作为重大政策决策的依据。

tip: 名词“病弱者”重音在首音节，现已较少使用。

senses.en: a document listing goods or services and the payment required
to send someone a document requesting payment for goods or services

ex.en: The plumber emailed an invoice after fixing our sink.
ex.zh: 水管工修好我们的水槽后，通过电子邮件发来了付款清单。

ex.en: Small businesses benefit from digital systems that track each invoice and remind customers when payments are due.
ex.zh: 小企业可以从追踪每张发票并提醒客户按时付款的数字系统中受益。

col: 就某项费用向某人开票
tip: invoice 通常用于要求付款；receipt 是已付款的收据。

senses.en: The religion followed by Muslims, teaching belief in one God

ex.en: Our guide explained how Islam influences the mosque's design.
ex.zh: 导游解释了伊斯兰教如何影响这座清真寺的设计。

ex.en: Learning about Islam and other major religions can help students understand the traditions of diverse communities.
ex.zh: 学习伊斯兰教及其他主要宗教，有助于学生理解不同群体的传统。

tip: Islam指宗教；Muslim指穆斯林或穆斯林的。

senses.en: a soft sea animal with hanging tentacles that can sting

ex.en: A translucent jellyfish drifted past our boat this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，一只半透明的水母从我们船边漂过。

ex.en: Rising ocean temperatures may encourage jellyfish populations to grow, potentially disrupting marine ecosystems and coastal tourism.
ex.zh: 海洋温度上升可能促使水母数量增加，进而扰乱海洋生态系统并影响沿海旅游业。

tip: 复数通常仍用 jellyfish；它不是鱼类。

senses.en: a hole in a lock into which a key fits

ex.en: I struggled to find the keyhole in the dark.
ex.zh: 黑暗中，我费了好大劲才找到钥匙孔。

ex.en: Modern electronic locks remove the need for a traditional keyhole, although they may create new security risks.
ex.zh: 现代电子锁不再需要传统的钥匙孔，不过也可能带来新的安全风险。

col: put a key in the keyhole
tip: keyhole surgery指小切口手术，不是钥匙孔手术。

senses.en: To take someone away illegally and hold them captive

ex.en: In the film, criminals kidnap a wealthy businessman.
ex.zh: 电影中，犯罪分子绑架了一位富商。

ex.en: International cooperation helps police investigate criminal groups that kidnap people and demand money for their release.
ex.zh: 国际合作有助于警方调查绑架他人并索要赎金的犯罪团伙。

tip: 不限于儿童；常用过去式kidnapped，分词kidnapping。

senses.en: Either of two organs that filter blood and produce urine.

ex.en: The doctor checked his kidneys during a routine examination.
ex.zh: 医生在常规检查中检查了他的肾脏。

ex.en: Public health campaigns should explain how managing blood pressure can help prevent kidney disease.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传应说明控制血压如何有助于预防肾病。

tip: kidney是可数名词；医学形容词renal表示“肾的”。

senses.en: Riding a board across water while pulled by a kite.

ex.en: My cousin tried kitesurfing at the beach yesterday.
ex.zh: 我表亲昨天在海滩尝试了风筝冲浪。

ex.en: Coastal resorts offering kitesurfing should separate training areas from swimming zones to reduce accidents.
ex.zh: 提供风筝冲浪活动的海滨度假区应将训练区与游泳区分开，以减少事故。

tip: 指由风筝牵引滑行，区别于帆板运动windsurfing。

senses.en: Someone whose job involves hard physical work.

ex.en: A laborer carried heavy bricks across the building site.
ex.zh: 一名劳工扛着沉重的砖块穿过建筑工地。

ex.en: Every construction laborer should receive safety training and suitable protective equipment before starting work on site.
ex.zh: 每位建筑劳工都应在进场工作前接受安全培训，并获得合适的防护装备。

tip: 美式拼写；英式为labourer，强调体力劳动。

senses.en: A boy or young man, especially in informal British English.

ex.en: A friendly lad helped us carry the bags.
ex.zh: 一个友善的小伙子帮我们提了袋子。

ex.en: As a young lad, the novelist experienced rural poverty, which later became a central theme in his work.
ex.zh: 这位小说家年少时经历过乡村贫困，这后来成为他作品的核心主题。

tip: 偏英式口语；正式写作宜用boy或young man。

senses.en: A place where waste is buried in the ground.
The disposal of waste by burying it in the ground.

ex.en: The truck carried our rubbish to a nearby landfill.
ex.zh: 卡车把我们的垃圾运到了附近的填埋场。

ex.en: Expanding recycling services could reduce the amount of household waste sent to landfill each year.
ex.zh: 扩大回收服务范围可以减少每年送去填埋的生活垃圾量。

tip: 指填埋场时可数；指填埋处理时通常不可数。

senses.en: mostly or to a great extent

ex.en: The beach was largely empty when we arrived.
ex.zh: 我们到达时，海滩上几乎没什么人。

ex.en: The success of public health campaigns depends largely on clear communication and widespread community trust.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传活动的成功很大程度上取决于清晰的沟通和广泛的社区信任。

tip: 表示主要或大体上，不表示物体体积很大。

senses.en: the second of two people or things already mentioned
closer to the end of a period or sequence

ex.en: We tried swimming and cycling, but preferred the latter.
ex.zh: 我们尝试了游泳和骑车，但更喜欢后者。

ex.en: Although both prevention and treatment deserve funding, healthcare budgets often devote more resources to the latter.
ex.zh: 尽管预防和治疗都值得投入资金，医疗预算往往将更多资源用于后者。

tip: the latter指两者中的后者，不等于later。

senses.en: the chance that something will happen

ex.en: Dark clouds increased the likelihood of rain this afternoon.
ex.zh: 乌云增加了今天下午下雨的可能性。

ex.en: Regular physical activity can reduce the likelihood of developing certain health conditions later in life.
ex.zh: 经常进行体育活动可以降低晚年患上某些疾病的可能性。

tip: 常用likelihood of doing或likelihood that从句。

senses.en: In the same way, or also.

ex.en: I folded my umbrella, and my sister did likewise.
ex.zh: 我收起雨伞，姐姐也照做了。

ex.en: Public libraries provide free internet access; likewise, community centres help residents develop essential digital skills.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆提供免费上网服务；同样，社区中心也帮助居民培养必要的数字技能。

tip: 较正式，常用于连接相似情况；do likewise意为照做。

senses.en: The ability to read and write.
Basic knowledge and skills needed in a particular area.

ex.en: The library offers free literacy classes for local adults.
ex.zh: 图书馆为当地成年人提供免费的读写课程。

ex.en: Improving digital literacy helps older adults access essential services and participate more fully in modern society.
ex.zh: 提高数字素养有助于老年人获取必要服务，更充分地参与现代社会生活。

tip: 不可数；digital literacy指数字素养，不只是识字。

senses.en: farm animals kept for food, materials, or work

ex.en: The farmer moved the livestock into a sheltered field.
ex.zh: 农民把牲畜赶进了一块有遮蔽的田地。

ex.en: Raising livestock requires substantial land and water resources, which can increase pressure on ecosystems in dry regions.
ex.zh: 饲养牲畜需要大量土地和水资源，这可能加剧干旱地区生态系统的压力。

tip: 集合名词，不加-s；表示活的农场动物。

senses.en: Sadness caused by feeling alone or lacking close relationships

ex.en: Calling an old friend helped ease my loneliness.
ex.zh: 给一位老朋友打电话缓解了我的孤独感。

ex.en: Community activities can reduce loneliness among older adults by creating opportunities for regular and meaningful social contact.
ex.zh: 社区活动能提供定期且有意义的社交机会，从而减轻老年人的孤独感。

tip: loneliness强调难过；solitude可指享受独处。

senses.en: Feeling unhappy because you lack company
Quiet and remote, with few or no people

ex.en: I felt lonesome after my sister moved away.
ex.zh: 姐姐搬走后，我感到很寂寞。

ex.en: Older adults may feel lonesome after retirement, especially if they have few opportunities for regular social contact.
ex.zh: 老年人退休后可能会感到孤独，尤其是在缺少日常社交机会的情况下。

tip: 多见于美式英语；lonely更通用，alone只表示独自一人。

senses.en: continuing or having effects over a long period

ex.en: We need a long-term plan for our garden.
ex.zh: 我们需要为花园制定一个长期规划。

ex.en: Investment in public transport can bring long-term benefits to both local economies and the environment.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通可以为地方经济和环境带来长期效益。

tip: 作定语常用连字符；in the long term不加。

senses.en: a place's angular distance east or west of the prime meridian

ex.en: Our guide checked our longitude before steering the boat east.
ex.zh: 向导在把船驶向东边之前查看了我们所在位置的经度。

ex.en: Accurate measurements of longitude and latitude allow navigation systems to determine a vehicle's position on Earth.
ex.zh: 准确测量经纬度能让导航系统确定车辆在地球上的位置。

tip: longitude是经度，分东西；latitude是纬度，分南北。

senses.en: having little chance of harm, loss, or failure

ex.en: We chose a low-risk investment for our savings.
ex.zh: 我们为储蓄选择了一项低风险投资。

ex.en: Low-risk financial products may appeal to households that prioritise stability over potentially higher returns.
ex.zh: 低风险金融产品可能吸引那些更重视稳定而非潜在高回报的家庭。

tip: low-risk表示风险较低，不等于完全无风险。

senses.en: made or caused by people rather than occurring naturally

ex.en: We walked around a man-made lake near the airport.
ex.zh: 我们绕着机场附近的一个人工湖散步。

ex.en: Man-made barriers such as dams can disrupt river ecosystems by preventing fish from reaching their breeding grounds.
ex.zh: 水坝等人工屏障会阻碍鱼类到达繁殖地，从而破坏河流生态系统。

tip: 强调由人制造或造成；也可用human-made。

senses.en: to produce goods, usually in large quantities using machinery
the process of producing goods, especially in factories

ex.en: The factory manufactures bicycles that fold into small bags.
ex.zh: 这家工厂生产可折叠后装入小包的自行车。

ex.en: Companies that manufacture electronic devices should take greater responsibility for recycling their products at the end of use.
ex.zh: 制造电子设备的企业应承担更多责任，回收使用寿命结束的产品。

tip: 多指工厂批量生产；名词制造商是manufacturer。

senses.en: the blank space around a page or an area's edge
the difference between amounts or extra space for safety
the difference between selling price and production cost

ex.en: Leave a wide margin for your teacher's comments.
ex.zh: 留出宽一些的页边空白，方便老师写评语。

ex.en: Small retailers often operate on a narrow profit margin, making them particularly vulnerable to rising energy costs.
ex.zh: 小型零售商往往利润微薄，因此尤其容易受到能源成本上涨的冲击。

col: 宽阔的页边空白；很大的差距
tip: by a narrow margin表示以微小差距获胜等。

senses.en: Relating to the sea or organisms living in it
Relating to ships and transport by sea
A soldier trained to serve on land and at sea

ex.en: We watched a documentary about marine life last night.
ex.zh: 我们昨晚看了一部关于海洋生物的纪录片。

ex.en: Plastic pollution threatens marine ecosystems and reduces the income of communities that depend on fishing.
ex.zh: 塑料污染威胁海洋生态系统，并减少依靠捕鱼为生的社区的收入。

tip: marine侧重海洋；海军的通常用naval。

senses.en: Someone or something that causes great admiration or surprise
To feel great surprise or admiration

ex.en: We marvelled at the tiny bird's beautifully woven nest.
ex.zh: 那只小鸟精巧编织的巢让我们惊叹不已。

ex.en: The new bridge is an engineering marvel that connects isolated communities and improves access to essential services.
ex.zh: 这座新桥是一项工程奇迹，连接了偏远社区，并让居民更方便地获得基本服务。

tip: 动词常接at；英式过去式marvelled，美式marveled。

senses.en: communication channels that deliver information to very large audiences

ex.en: My grandparents relied on mass media for their daily news.
ex.zh: 我的祖父母过去依靠大众传媒获取每日新闻。

ex.en: Mass media can shape public attitudes towards environmental issues by deciding which stories receive widespread attention.
ex.zh: 大众传媒可以通过决定哪些报道受到广泛关注，来影响公众对环境问题的态度。

tip: 泛指大众传媒常用the mass media，通常接复数谓语。

senses.en: an exceptionally fine work of art, literature, or skill

ex.en: Everyone stopped to admire the masterpiece above the fireplace.
ex.zh: 大家都停下来欣赏壁炉上方的那幅杰作。

ex.en: Displaying a masterpiece in a public museum allows people from different backgrounds to appreciate artistic achievement.
ex.zh: 在公共博物馆展出杰作，能让不同背景的人欣赏艺术成就。

tip: 通常指作品，不用来指才华出众的人。

senses.en: relating to mathematics

ex.en: This puzzle really puts your mathematical skills to work.
ex.zh: 这道谜题真能让你运用数学技能。

ex.en: Mathematical models help researchers predict how rising temperatures may affect coastal communities over time.
ex.zh: 数学模型帮助研究人员预测气温上升可能如何逐步影响沿海社区。

tip: mathematics是学科名，虽以s结尾但用单数谓语。

senses.en: to increase something as much as possible or use it fully

ex.en: We added shelves to maximize space in our tiny kitchen.
ex.zh: 我们加装了架子，以充分利用小厨房的空间。

ex.en: Cities should improve public transport to maximize access to employment while reducing dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 城市应改善公共交通，尽可能增加就业机会的可及性，同时减少对私家车的依赖。

tip: 及物动词；英式也常拼作maximise。

senses.en: goods available for sale
to promote goods and encourage people to buy them

ex.en: The shop displays its new merchandise near the entrance.
ex.zh: 这家店在入口附近陈列新商品。

ex.en: Selling locally produced merchandise can support small businesses and reduce the environmental impact of transport.
ex.zh: 销售本地生产的商品可以扶持小企业，并减少运输对环境的影响。

tip: 名词不可数；动词词尾常读作/daɪz/。

senses.en: Kindness shown by choosing not to punish or harm someone.

ex.en: The teacher showed mercy and accepted my late homework.
ex.zh: 老师宽容地收下了我迟交的作业。

ex.en: A fair justice system should balance appropriate punishment with mercy towards people who genuinely seek to change.
ex.zh: 公平的司法制度应在适当惩罚与宽待真心寻求改变的人之间取得平衡。

tip: at the mercy of意为“任由……摆布”。

senses.en: only, and nothing more or more important

ex.en: I wasn't complaining; I was merely asking a question.
ex.zh: 我不是在抱怨，只是在问个问题。

ex.en: Building more roads merely shifts traffic problems elsewhere unless governments also invest in reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 除非政府同时投资可靠的公共交通，否则修建更多道路只会把交通问题转移到别处。

tip: 语气比only正式；通常置于实义动词前、be动词后。

senses.en: Happening halfway through an academic term or period in office.
An examination taken halfway through an academic term.

ex.en: Our mid-term exams start after the spring holiday.
ex.zh: 我们的期中考试在春假之后开始。

ex.en: Mid-term assessments can help teachers identify learning difficulties before students take their final examinations.
ex.zh: 期中测评有助于教师在学生参加期末考试之前发现学习困难。

tip: 也常写作midterm；作名词指期中考试，多见于美语。

senses.en: The movement of people to live in another place.
The regular movement of animals between regions, often with the seasons.
The transfer of data or software to another computer system.

ex.en: We watched the birds during their annual autumn migration.
ex.zh: 我们观察了正在进行一年一度秋季迁徙的鸟儿。

ex.en: Migration from rural areas to cities can increase pressure on housing while providing workers for expanding industries.
ex.zh: 农村人口向城市迁移可能加大住房压力，同时为不断扩张的行业提供劳动力。

col: 农村向城市的人口迁移
tip: migration泛指迁移；immigration侧重迁入。

senses.en: An important event or stage in development.
A roadside stone showing the distance to a place.

ex.en: Getting her first job was a milestone for Sara.
ex.zh: 找到第一份工作是萨拉人生中的一个里程碑。

ex.en: The opening of the railway marked a significant milestone in the region's economic development.
ex.zh: 这条铁路的开通标志着该地区经济发展的一个重要里程碑。

tip: 常指发展中的重要节点，常搭配in。

senses.en: a government department responsible for a particular area
the work or duties of a religious minister

ex.en: My aunt works at the ministry near the station.
ex.zh: 我姑姑在车站附近的政府部门工作。

ex.en: The education ministry should consult teachers before introducing major changes to the national school curriculum.
ex.zh: 教育部在对全国学校课程作出重大调整之前，应征求教师的意见。

tip: 政府部门名称常用Ministry of加领域名词。

senses.en: great unhappiness or suffering
extremely poor and uncomfortable living conditions

ex.en: The constant noise made her life a misery.
ex.zh: 持续不断的噪声让她苦不堪言。

ex.en: Improving access to affordable housing can reduce the misery experienced by families living in overcrowded temporary accommodation.
ex.zh: 改善可负担住房的供应，可以减轻住在拥挤临时住所中的家庭所承受的痛苦。

tip: 通常不可数；a misery可指令人痛苦的处境。

senses.en: bad luck or an unlucky event that causes difficulty

ex.en: We had the misfortune to miss the last train.
ex.zh: 我们很不巧，错过了末班火车。

ex.en: Strong community networks can help families recover from financial misfortune without becoming isolated from society.
ex.zh: 紧密的社区互助网络能帮助家庭摆脱经济困境，同时避免与社会隔绝。

tip: 表示厄运时不可数；表示具体不幸事件时可数。

senses.en: To make a low sound expressing pain or unhappiness.
To complain, especially in an annoying or repeated way.
A low sound of pain, or an expression of complaint.

ex.en: He moaned softly as the nurse examined his ankle.
ex.zh: 护士检查他的脚踝时，他轻轻呻吟着。

ex.en: Rather than moan about unreliable buses, residents could ask local authorities to improve public transport.
ex.zh: 居民与其抱怨公交车不准时，不如向地方政府提出改善公共交通的诉求。

tip: 表示抱怨时较口语化，常用moan about。

senses.en: The light that reaches Earth from the moon.

senses.zh: 兼职；私下兼第二份工作
senses.en: To do another paid job alongside your main job, often secretly.

ex.en: Moonlight shone through the curtains onto my pillow.
ex.zh: 月光透过窗帘照在我的枕头上。

ex.en: Artificial lighting can obscure natural moonlight, potentially affecting the behaviour of animals that are active at night.
ex.zh: 人工照明可能掩盖自然月光，从而影响夜行动物的行为。

tip: 月光是不可数名词；动词常接as表示兼职身份。

senses.en: A small motorcycle with a low-powered engine, sometimes with pedals

ex.en: She parked her moped beside the bakery this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，她把轻便摩托车停在面包店旁边。

ex.en: A moped can offer affordable transport for short journeys, although riders remain vulnerable on busy urban roads.
ex.zh: 轻便摩托车可以为短途出行提供经济的交通方式，不过骑行者在繁忙的城市道路上仍易受伤害。

tip: 名词读两音节；mope的过去式moped读作/məʊpt/。

senses.en: Used to add another fact supporting what was just said.

ex.en: The flat is spacious; moreover, it has a balcony.
ex.zh: 这套公寓很宽敞，而且还有一个阳台。

ex.en: Public parks provide space for exercise; moreover, they can strengthen community ties by encouraging informal social interaction.
ex.zh: 公共公园提供锻炼场所；此外，它们还可通过促进非正式的社交互动来加强社区联系。

tip: 正式递进副词；连接独立句时，前用句号或分号。

senses.en: Designed to perform several different tasks.

ex.en: Our multifunction printer can scan documents and make copies.
ex.zh: 我们的多功能打印机可以扫描文件和复印。

ex.en: Multifunction devices can help small businesses save office space by combining several essential services in one machine.
ex.zh: 多功能设备将几种必要功能集于一机，可以帮助小企业节省办公空间。

tip: 作形容词，常放设备名词前；也可用multifunctional。

senses.en: Having large, strong muscles.
Relating to the muscles of the body.

ex.en: The muscular swimmer lifted the heavy box easily.
ex.zh: 那位肌肉发达的游泳运动员轻松举起了沉重的箱子。

ex.en: Regular resistance training can improve muscular strength and help older adults maintain their independence.
ex.zh: 定期进行抗阻训练可以增强肌肉力量，帮助老年人保持独立生活的能力。

tip: 既可指肌肉发达，也可仅表示与肌肉有关。

senses.en: The person or voice telling a story

ex.en: The narrator's gentle voice helped me fall asleep.
ex.zh: 旁白者轻柔的声音帮助我入睡。

ex.en: An unreliable narrator encourages readers to question events and consider how personal perspectives shape their understanding of reality.
ex.zh: 不可靠的叙述者促使读者质疑事件，并思考个人视角如何塑造对现实的理解。

tip: 叙述者不一定是作者；小说中可由虚构人物担任。

senses.en: Finding and following a route to a destination.

senses.zh: 网站或应用的浏览操作
senses.en: Moving between pages or sections of a website or application.

ex.en: We used a compass for navigation during our hike.
ex.zh: 徒步时，我们用指南针辨别方向。

ex.en: Clear website navigation helps users find essential information quickly, making online public services more accessible to everyone.
ex.zh: 清晰的网站导航能帮助用户快速找到重要信息，让所有人都更方便地使用在线公共服务。

tip: 不仅指航海，也用于道路导航和网页浏览。

senses.en: Despite what has just been mentioned.

ex.en: The climb was tiring; nevertheless, we enjoyed the view.
ex.zh: 爬山很累，但我们仍然欣赏到了美景。

ex.en: Public transport improvements require considerable investment; nevertheless, they can reduce congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通需要大量投资，但这能缓解拥堵并改善城市空气质量。

tip: 是副词，不是连词；连接独立句时可用分号。

senses.en: Not eligible for money to be returned after payment.

ex.en: We chose cheaper tickets, but they were non-refundable.
ex.zh: 我们选了更便宜的票，但这些票不能退款。

ex.en: Non-refundable booking fees can discourage travellers from changing plans, even when their circumstances unexpectedly change.
ex.zh: 不可退还的预订费可能让旅客不愿更改计划，即使他们的情况突然发生了变化。

tip: 指已付款项不能退回，不表示物品不能归还。

senses.en: important or unusual enough to deserve attention
a famous or important person, especially in a particular community

ex.en: Her balcony is notable for its bright yellow flowers.
ex.zh: 她家的阳台因鲜艳的黄色花朵而引人注目。

ex.en: The city has achieved a notable reduction in air pollution since introducing stricter vehicle standards.
ex.zh: 自实施更严格的车辆标准以来，该市的空气污染已显著减少。

tip: notable for表示因……而出名或引人注意。

senses.en: the activity of writing down important information while listening or reading

ex.en: Note-taking helps me remember what happens during meetings.
ex.zh: 记笔记有助于我记住会议中的内容。

ex.en: Effective note-taking allows students to identify key arguments and review complex material more efficiently after lectures.
ex.zh: 有效记笔记能帮助学生识别关键论点，并在课后更高效地复习复杂内容。

tip: 通常不可数；动词短语用take notes。

senses.en: Easy to see or recognize.

ex.en: There is a noticeable scratch on my new table.
ex.zh: 我的新桌子上有一道明显的划痕。

ex.en: The introduction of electric buses has led to a noticeable reduction in noise near busy roads.
ex.zh: 引入电动公交车后，繁忙道路附近的噪声明显减少了。

tip: noticeable指容易察觉；notable侧重值得关注。

senses.en: A person who writes novels.

ex.en: The novelist spends every morning writing at her kitchen table.
ex.zh: 这位小说家每天上午都在厨房的桌边写作。

ex.en: A skilled novelist can reveal social inequalities through characters whose experiences differ greatly from those of readers.
ex.zh: 技艺娴熟的小说家可以通过经历与读者大不相同的人物，揭示社会不平等。

tip: novelist通常指长篇小说作家，novel是长篇小说。

senses.en: the quality of being new, unusual, or unfamiliar
something new or unusual that attracts interest
a small unusual object made mainly for amusement

ex.en: The novelty of sleeping in a tent soon wore off.
ex.zh: 睡帐篷的新鲜感很快就消退了。

ex.en: Although the novelty of new technology attracts consumers, long-term adoption depends on practical benefits and affordability.
ex.zh: 虽然新技术的新颖性会吸引消费者，但长期采用仍取决于实际益处和价格是否可负担。

tip: 指新奇感时不可数；指新鲜事物或小玩意儿时可数。

senses.en: someone with little experience in a particular activity

ex.en: As a gardening novice, I often forget to water seedlings.
ex.zh: 作为园艺新手，我常常忘记给幼苗浇水。

ex.en: Structured mentoring can help a novice develop the confidence needed to manage a classroom effectively.
ex.zh: 有系统的指导能帮助新手建立有效管理课堂所需的信心。

tip: 表示某方面的新手，常用a novice at/in。

senses.en: the process of obtaining and using food for health
the study of how food affects health and growth

ex.en: Good nutrition helps children grow and stay active.
ex.zh: 良好的营养有助于儿童成长并保持活力。

ex.en: Schools should teach nutrition so that young people can make informed choices about their daily diets.
ex.zh: 学校应教授营养知识，让年轻人能够在了解相关信息的基础上选择日常饮食。

tip: nutrition不可数；nutrient指具体的营养物质。

senses.en: A long pole with a flat blade for rowing boats

ex.en: He lifted one oar and gently pushed the boat away.
ex.zh: 他抬起一支船桨，轻轻把船撑开。

ex.en: Visitors can explore the lake in traditional boats, using oars rather than engines to minimise disturbance to wildlife.
ex.zh: 游客可以乘传统小船游湖，用桨而非发动机推进，以尽量减少对野生动物的干扰。

tip: oar通常支在船侧划动；paddle通常手持划动。

senses.en: having excessive body fat that may harm health

ex.en: The vet said our cat was obese and needed exercise.
ex.zh: 兽医说我们家的猫过于肥胖，需要运动。

ex.en: People who are obese should have access to supportive healthcare without facing discrimination or blame.
ex.zh: 肥胖人群应能获得支持性的医疗服务，而不受歧视或责备。

tip: 属医学用语，程度通常重于overweight；避免随意评价他人。

senses.en: An expression of opposition, or a reason for opposing something.

ex.en: My only objection is that the tickets cost too much.
ex.zh: 我唯一的反对理由是票价太高。

ex.en: Residents raised an objection to the proposed airport expansion because of its likely impact on noise levels.
ex.zh: 居民对拟议的机场扩建提出异议，因为这可能加剧噪声。

tip: objection to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: Something you aim to achieve.
Based on facts rather than personal feelings or opinions.

ex.en: My main objective is to finish the race.
ex.zh: 我的主要目标是跑完全程。

ex.en: Researchers should remain objective when evaluating evidence about the effects of homework on student achievement.
ex.zh: 研究人员在评估家庭作业对学生成绩影响的证据时，应保持客观。

tip: 名词指目标；形容词指客观的，反义词为subjective。

senses.en: To get something, especially through effort or a formal process.

ex.en: You can obtain a replacement key from the landlord.
ex.zh: 你可以从房东那里拿到一把替换钥匙。

ex.en: Researchers must obtain informed consent from participants before collecting personal data for a scientific study.
ex.zh: 研究人员在为科学研究收集个人数据之前，必须取得参与者的知情同意。

tip: 比get正式；常用obtain sth from sb或某机构。

senses.en: the region including Australia, New Zealand, and many Pacific islands

ex.en: Our neighbour travelled around Oceania with a small backpack.
ex.zh: 我们的邻居背着一个小背包游历了大洋洲。

ex.en: Many island communities in Oceania face growing risks from rising sea levels and increasingly severe storms.
ex.zh: 大洋洲的许多岛屿社区正面临海平面上升和风暴日益猛烈带来的更大风险。

tip: 专有名词，首字母大写；前面通常不加the。

senses.en: A noticeable smell, especially an unpleasant one.

ex.en: A strange odour came from the kitchen bin.
ex.zh: 厨房垃圾桶里飘出一股怪味。

ex.en: Residents may oppose new waste facilities if they expect unpleasant odours to affect their quality of life.
ex.zh: 如果居民预计难闻的气味会影响生活质量，他们可能会反对新建垃圾处理设施。

tip: 英式拼写odour，美式odor；常指难闻气味。

senses.en: not working during a particular period

ex.en: An off-duty nurse helped when my grandfather fell.
ex.zh: 我爷爷摔倒时，一位不当班的护士帮了忙。

ex.en: Providing comfortable accommodation allows off-duty staff to rest properly, improving their performance during subsequent shifts.
ex.zh: 提供舒适的住宿能让下班的员工充分休息，从而改善他们下一班的工作表现。

tip: 名词前用off-duty；作表语通常写off duty。

senses.en: a person who controls a machine or piece of equipment
a person or company that runs a business or service
a person who connects calls or provides telephone assistance

ex.en: The crane operator carefully lowered the beam into place.
ex.zh: 起重机操作员小心地把横梁降到指定位置。

ex.en: Every public transport operator should ensure that its services remain accessible to passengers with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 每家公共交通运营商都应确保行动不便的乘客能够使用其服务。

tip: 既指操作设备的人，也指经营服务的公司。

senses.en: Relating to light or devices that use light.
Relating to sight or the way the eyes work.

ex.en: This optical illusion makes the flat drawing look three-dimensional.
ex.zh: 这种视错觉让平面的图画看起来像立体的。

ex.en: Optical fibres enable rapid data transmission, supporting the expansion of reliable internet access in remote communities.
ex.zh: 光纤能实现快速数据传输，帮助可靠的互联网服务覆盖偏远社区。

tip: optical涉及光或视觉；optical illusion指视错觉。

senses.en: The outer parts of a town or city; usually plural

ex.en: My aunt lives on the outskirts near a farm.
ex.zh: 我姑妈住在市郊，附近有个农场。

ex.en: Building affordable housing on the outskirts can reduce costs but may increase residents' dependence on cars.
ex.zh: 在市郊建设经济适用房可以降低成本，但可能增加居民对汽车的依赖。

tip: 通常用复数 outskirts，搭配 on 而非 in。

senses.en: the areas around the outer edge of a town or city

ex.en: Their new house is on the outskirts of town.
ex.zh: 他们的新房子在镇子边上。

ex.en: Building affordable homes on the outskirts may reduce housing costs but increase residents' dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 在市郊建设可负担住房可能降低住房成本，却会增加居民对私家车的依赖。

tip: 固定用复数，常说on the outskirts of a city。

senses.en: Towards the outside or away from the centre

ex.en: The windows open outwards, so keep the balcony clear.
ex.zh: 窗户向外开，所以请保持阳台通畅。

ex.en: As cities expand outwards, surrounding farmland often disappears, creating concerns about food security and habitat loss.
ex.zh: 随着城市向外扩张，周边农田往往逐渐消失，引发人们对粮食安全和栖息地流失的担忧。

tip: outwards 是副词；作定语需用 outward。

senses.en: Not paid, returned, or completed by the expected time.
Needed or deserved much earlier than now.

ex.en: I found an overdue library book under my bed.
ex.zh: 我在床底下发现了一本逾期未还的图书馆藏书。

ex.en: Investment in rural public transport is long overdue, as many residents still lack reliable services.
ex.zh: 农村公共交通早就该得到投资，因为许多居民至今仍缺乏可靠的交通服务。

col: 逾期未还的图书馆书籍
tip: long overdue强调“早就该有或该做”，不只是迟到。

senses.en: a large bovine, often a castrated male, used for work

ex.en: The ox pulled a wooden cart along the path.
ex.zh: 那头役牛沿着小路拉着一辆木车。

ex.en: Before agricultural machinery became widespread, farmers in many regions relied on oxen to plough their fields.
ex.zh: 农业机械普及之前，许多地区的农民依靠役牛犁地。

tip: 复数是oxen；多指役牛，不等同于未阉割公牛bull。

senses.en: A gas whose molecules each contain three oxygen atoms.

ex.en: High ozone levels kept us from jogging outside today.
ex.zh: 今天臭氧浓度高，我们没有到户外慢跑。

ex.en: While ozone high in the atmosphere protects life, ground-level ozone can damage human health and crops.
ex.zh: 尽管高空中的臭氧能保护生命，近地面的臭氧却会损害人体健康和农作物。

tip: 臭氧不可数；高空臭氧有保护作用，近地面臭氧有害。

senses.en: Equipment that slows a fall through the air
To jump or drop something from aircraft using a parachute

ex.en: Her parachute opened smoothly above the green fields.
ex.zh: 她的降落伞在绿色田野上空顺利张开。

ex.en: Rescue teams used parachutes to deliver essential supplies to villages isolated by severe flooding.
ex.zh: 救援队利用降落伞向被严重洪灾隔绝的村庄投送必需物资。

tip: 作动词时，既可指人跳伞，也可指空投物资。

senses.en: not paid by the date when payment was required

ex.en: I finally paid the past-due bill this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我终于付清了那笔逾期账单。

ex.en: Financial counselling can help households manage past-due payments and avoid falling further into debt.
ex.zh: 财务咨询可以帮助家庭处理逾期款项，避免债务进一步加重。

tip: 名词前可加连字符；表语通常写作 past due。

senses.en: An activity you enjoy doing in your free time.

ex.en: Gardening became her favourite pastime after she retired.
ex.zh: 退休后，园艺成了她最喜欢的消遣。

ex.en: Outdoor pastimes can improve mental health while encouraging people to spend less time using electronic devices.
ex.zh: 户外休闲活动可以改善心理健康，同时鼓励人们减少使用电子设备的时间。

tip: 指闲暇活动；注意拼写只有一个s。

senses.en: so poor or ineffective that it deserves strong criticism
making you feel pity because of suffering or helplessness

ex.en: The broken shower produced only a pathetic trickle.
ex.zh: 坏掉的淋浴器只能流出少得可怜的一点水。

ex.en: Residents described the council's response to repeated flooding as pathetic, demanding immediate investment in better drainage.
ex.zh: 居民认为市政委员会应对反复洪灾的表现差劲，要求立即投资改善排水设施。

tip: 常带强烈贬义，不宜随意用来形容他人。

senses.en: To move around an area regularly to maintain safety.
An activity or group that checks an area for danger.

ex.en: Two guards patrol the park after dark each evening.
ex.zh: 每天傍晚天黑后，两名警卫都会在公园巡逻。

ex.en: Rangers patrol protected forests to prevent illegal logging and monitor threats to endangered wildlife.
ex.zh: 护林员在受保护的森林中巡逻，以防止非法伐木并监测濒危野生动物面临的威胁。

tip: 过去式patrolled，进行式patrolling，均双写l。

senses.en: a male peafowl with long, colourful feathers it spreads out

ex.en: The peacock spread its brilliant feathers beside the pond.
ex.zh: 那只雄孔雀在池塘边展开了鲜艳的羽毛。

ex.en: The elaborate display of a peacock illustrates how mate selection can influence the evolution of animal appearance.
ex.zh: 雄孔雀华丽的开屏展示说明，配偶选择能够影响动物外形的进化。

tip: 严格说peacock指雄孔雀，雌孔雀叫peahen。

senses.en: strange or unusual, sometimes in an unpleasant way
belonging only to a particular person, group, place, or thing

ex.en: A peculiar smell came from the cupboard under the stairs.
ex.zh: 楼梯下的柜子里飘出一股怪味。

ex.en: Some environmental challenges are peculiar to coastal cities, including saltwater intrusion and damage caused by storm surges.
ex.zh: 一些环境挑战是沿海城市特有的，包括海水入侵和风暴潮造成的破坏。

tip: peculiar to表示“……特有的”，不是“奇怪”。

senses.en: Musical instruments played by hitting, shaking, or scraping them.

ex.en: My sister plays percussion in the school band.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在学校乐队里演奏打击乐器。

ex.en: Group percussion lessons can help children develop coordination while encouraging cooperation and creative expression.
ex.zh: 集体打击乐课程可以帮助儿童发展协调能力，同时促进合作与创造性表达。

tip: 总称时不可数；一件打击乐器用a percussion instrument。

senses.en: Able to make people believe something or agree with you

ex.en: Her persuasive explanation finally convinced me to join the club.
ex.zh: 她那番有说服力的解释终于让我同意加入俱乐部。

ex.en: Public health campaigns need persuasive messages that encourage people to adopt healthier daily habits.
ex.zh: 公共健康宣传需要有说服力的信息，鼓励人们养成更健康的日常习惯。

tip: 通常形容论点或表达有说服力，不作名词。

senses.en: Someone who studies fundamental questions about existence, knowledge, and values.

ex.en: The philosopher asked us what makes a life meaningful.
ex.zh: 那位哲学家问我们，什么使人生有意义。

ex.en: A philosopher might question whether economic growth should be the main measure of a society's progress.
ex.zh: 哲学家可能会质疑，经济增长是否应当成为衡量社会进步的主要标准。

tip: philosopher指人，philosophy指哲学或理念。

senses.en: relating to photography or photographs
able to remember visual details with great accuracy

ex.en: She packed her photographic equipment before the sunrise walk.
ex.zh: 她在出发晨走看日出前收好了摄影器材。

ex.en: Photographic evidence allows researchers to document changes in glacier size and communicate climate trends to the public.
ex.zh: 照片证据使研究人员能够记录冰川大小的变化，并向公众传达气候趋势。

tip: photographic memory指记忆极精确，并非照片存储。

senses.en: A small raised spot on the skin, often red.

ex.en: A small pimple appeared on my chin overnight.
ex.zh: 一夜之间，我的下巴上冒出了一颗小痘痘。

ex.en: Teenagers who develop pimples may benefit from gentle skincare rather than frequent washing with harsh soap.
ex.zh: 长痘痘的青少年采用温和的护肤方式，可能比频繁使用刺激性肥皂洗脸更有益。

tip: pimple指单颗痘痘；acne指痤疮这种皮肤问题。

senses.en: a mixture that hardens, used for walls, ceilings, or casts
a small sticky covering used to protect a minor wound
cover a surface with plaster

ex.en: Small pieces of plaster fell from the kitchen ceiling.
ex.zh: 小块灰泥从厨房天花板上掉了下来。

ex.en: Restoring historic buildings often requires skilled workers who can repair damaged plaster without harming original decorative features.
ex.zh: 修复历史建筑往往需要熟练工人，他们能在不损坏原有装饰的情况下修补受损灰泥。

tip: 表灰泥时通常不可数；英式英语中a plaster是创可贴。

senses.en: Available in large amounts or numbers.

ex.en: Fresh berries are plentiful at the market this summer.
ex.zh: 今年夏天，市场上的新鲜浆果供应充足。

ex.en: Regions with plentiful sunshine are well placed to generate affordable electricity through investment in solar technology.
ex.zh: 阳光充足的地区具备有利条件，可以通过投资太阳能技术生产价格低廉的电力。

tip: 表示物资或机会充足，不表示一个人富有。

senses.en: A farm tool that turns soil before crops are planted
To turn soil with a plough before planting

ex.en: The farmer pulled an old plough from the shed.
ex.zh: 农民从棚里拖出了一把旧犁。

ex.en: Farmers who plough steep slopes too frequently may increase soil erosion and reduce long-term agricultural productivity.
ex.zh: 过于频繁地耕作陡坡的农民可能会加剧水土流失，并降低长期农业生产力。

tip: 美式拼作plow；两种拼写都读/plaʊ/。

senses.en: A card game involving bets on the strength of players' hands.
A metal rod used to move fuel in a fire.

ex.en: We played poker with plastic counters after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们用塑料筹码玩扑克。

ex.en: Researchers study poker to understand how people make decisions when information is incomplete and outcomes are uncertain.
ex.zh: 研究人员通过研究扑克，了解人们在信息不完整、结果不确定时如何作出决策。

tip: poker是特定扑克游戏，不泛指所有纸牌。

senses.en: A substance that makes air, water, or soil dirty or harmful.

ex.en: This filter removes harmful pollutants from our drinking water.
ex.zh: 这个过滤器能去除我们饮用水中的有害污染物。

ex.en: Stricter controls on industrial pollutants could improve air quality and reduce respiratory illness in urban areas.
ex.zh: 更严格地管控工业污染物可以改善空气质量，减少城市地区的呼吸道疾病。

tip: pollutant指具体污染物，可数；pollution指污染。

senses.en: Birds such as chickens kept for their meat or eggs.
Meat from farmed birds such as chickens and turkeys.

ex.en: My aunt keeps poultry in a spacious backyard enclosure.
ex.zh: 我阿姨在后院一个宽敞的围栏里养家禽。

ex.en: Higher welfare standards for poultry can improve animal health, although they may increase production costs.
ex.zh: 提高家禽福利标准可以改善动物健康，但可能增加生产成本。

tip: 不用a poultry；表示一只家禽可说a chicken等。

senses.en: Happening or appearing before the thing being discussed.

ex.en: I slept badly on the night preceding my interview.
ex.zh: 面试前一晚，我睡得很不好。

ex.en: The survey revealed that household energy consumption had fallen significantly compared with the preceding year.
ex.zh: 调查显示，与前一年相比，家庭能源消耗已显著下降。

tip: preceding指所谈时间或事物之前的，不等于现在之前。

senses.en: The act of keeping something safe from damage or loss.
The process of treating food to prevent it from spoiling.

ex.en: These old photographs need careful preservation to prevent further damage.
ex.zh: 这些老照片需要妥善保存，以免进一步受损。

ex.en: The preservation of historic buildings can strengthen local identity while attracting visitors and supporting small businesses.
ex.zh: 保护历史建筑可以增强地方认同感，同时吸引游客并扶持小企业。

tip: 通常不可数；the preservation of后接保护对象。

senses.en: Probably true, based on what is known or reasonably expected.

ex.en: Her coat is gone, so presumably she has left.
ex.zh: 她的外套不见了，想必她已经离开了。

ex.en: More frequent bus services would presumably encourage commuters to leave their cars at home, reducing urban traffic.
ex.zh: 更频繁的公交班次想必会鼓励通勤者不开车出门，从而缓解城市交通拥堵。

tip: 表示有依据的推测，不等于certainly的确定语气。

senses.en: Very basic, without advanced features or modern comforts.
Belonging to an early stage of development.

ex.en: The campsite had only a primitive outdoor cooking area.
ex.zh: 营地只有一个简陋的户外烹饪区。

ex.en: Although these tools appear primitive, they reveal considerable skill in selecting and shaping locally available materials.
ex.zh: 尽管这些工具看起来粗糙，却体现了选择和加工当地材料的高超技艺。

tip: 形容设施可指简陋；用于当代民族或文化可能含贬义。

senses.en: how likely something is to happen

ex.en: Dark clouds suggest a high probability of rain tonight.
ex.zh: 乌云表明今晚下雨的可能性很大。

ex.en: Improved weather models allow scientists to estimate the probability of extreme rainfall with greater accuracy.
ex.zh: 改进后的天气模型使科学家能够更准确地估算极端降雨的概率。

tip: 常接of加名词或动名词；也可接that从句。

senses.en: Important, well known, or influential
Easily noticed because of position, size, or shape

ex.en: A prominent local artist opened the exhibition yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天，一位当地著名艺术家为展览揭幕。

ex.en: Universities play a prominent role in developing technologies that support the transition to renewable energy.
ex.zh: 大学在开发支持向可再生能源转型的技术方面发挥着重要作用。

tip: 既可指人物重要知名，也可指位置或外形显眼。

senses.en: Showing signs of likely future success or improvement.

ex.en: Your first attempt looks promising; keep practising every day.
ex.zh: 你的初次尝试看起来很有希望；坚持每天练习吧。

ex.en: Solar energy offers a promising solution for remote communities that lack access to reliable electricity.
ex.zh: 太阳能为缺乏可靠电力供应的偏远社区提供了一种前景可期的解决方案。

tip: 表示有成功的潜力，不等于已经成功。

senses.en: a part or share of a whole
the relationship in size or amount between things

ex.en: A large proportion of my wages goes on rent.
ex.zh: 我的工资很大一部分用来付房租。

ex.en: The proportion of residents using public transport increased after the city introduced cheaper monthly passes.
ex.zh: 该市推出更便宜的月票后，使用公共交通的居民比例上升了。

tip: a proportion of后谓语单复数取决于所指名词。

senses.en: Financially successful and enjoying wealth or economic growth

ex.en: The once quiet village is now a prosperous market town.
ex.zh: 这个曾经安静的村庄如今已成为繁荣的集镇。

ex.en: A prosperous economy can generate the resources needed to improve education, healthcare, and public infrastructure.
ex.zh: 繁荣的经济能够创造改善教育、医疗和公共基础设施所需的资源。

tip: 常修饰国家、地区或经济，强调经济上的兴旺。

senses.en: A major administrative area within a country
An area of responsibility or expertise belonging to someone

ex.en: My aunt lives in a quiet village in this province.
ex.zh: 我姑姑住在这个省的一个安静村庄里。

ex.en: Each province should adapt its transport policies to local geography, population density, and economic needs.
ex.zh: 各省应根据当地地理条件、人口密度和经济需求调整交通政策。

tip: 表示“职责领域”时常用the province of。

senses.en: Attention given to someone or something by the media.
Activities intended to attract public attention to something.

ex.en: The new bakery received plenty of publicity after opening.
ex.zh: 那家新面包店开业后获得了大量媒体关注。

ex.en: Positive publicity can attract visitors to lesser-known destinations, creating employment opportunities for local residents.
ex.zh: 正面宣传可以吸引游客前往鲜为人知的目的地，为当地居民创造就业机会。

tip: 不可数；不同于advertising，不一定是付费广告。

senses.en: A small hole made by a sharp object, especially in tyres.
Make a small hole in something with a sharp object.

ex.en: A puncture in my bicycle tyre made me late.
ex.zh: 我的自行车轮胎被扎破了，害得我迟到了。

ex.en: Sharp debris on poorly maintained cycle lanes can puncture tyres and discourage residents from cycling to work.
ex.zh: 维护不善的自行车道上的尖锐碎屑可能扎破轮胎，使居民不愿骑车上班。

tip: 英式英语说get a puncture；美式常说get a flat。

senses.en: The effort to achieve or obtain something
The act of following someone to catch them
An activity you enjoy doing regularly

ex.en: Her pursuit of happiness led her to gardening.
ex.zh: 为了寻找快乐，她开始了园艺活动。

ex.en: The pursuit of economic growth should not come at the expense of environmental protection.
ex.zh: 追求经济增长不应以牺牲环境保护为代价。

tip: 表示追求或追赶通常不可数；消遣活动可数。

senses.en: Happening or produced every three months.
Once every three months.
A magazine published every three months.

ex.en: Our club holds quarterly meetings at the local library.
ex.zh: 我们俱乐部每季度在当地的图书馆开一次会。

ex.en: Quarterly reports allow investors to monitor company performance and identify emerging financial risks throughout the year.
ex.zh: 季度报告让投资者能够全年跟踪公司的表现，并识别新出现的财务风险。

tip: quarterly指每三个月一次，不是每四个月一次。

senses.en: A question or request for information
To ask about something or question whether it is correct

ex.en: The receptionist answered my query about the swimming pool.
ex.zh: 接待员回答了我关于游泳池的询问。

ex.en: Consumers should query unexpected charges on their bills rather than assume that automated payment systems are always accurate.
ex.zh: 消费者应对账单上的意外收费提出疑问，而不是认为自动支付系统总是准确的。

tip: query作动词可直接接所质疑的费用或决定。

senses.en: The state of having little noise or disturbance

ex.en: I enjoyed the quietness of the garden before breakfast.
ex.zh: 早饭前，我享受着花园里的宁静。

ex.en: The quietness of rural areas attracts residents seeking relief from the constant noise of urban life.
ex.zh: 乡村的宁静吸引着希望摆脱城市生活持续噪声的居民。

tip: 不可数名词；日常也常直接用quiet作名词。

senses.en: A system using radio waves to locate and track objects.

ex.en: The fishing boat has radar for navigating through fog.
ex.zh: 这艘渔船配有雷达，用于在雾中导航。

ex.en: Modern radar systems allow airports to monitor aircraft movements and maintain safety even in poor visibility.
ex.zh: 现代雷达系统让机场即使在能见度较差时也能监测飞机动向并保障安全。

tip: under the radar比喻未引起注意。

senses.en: Energy travelling through space or matter as waves or particles.
Medical treatment using radiation to destroy cancer cells.

ex.en: This special glass blocks much of the sun's ultraviolet radiation.
ex.zh: 这种特殊玻璃能阻挡大部分太阳紫外线辐射。

ex.en: Workers in nuclear facilities require protective equipment and regular monitoring to limit their exposure to radiation.
ex.zh: 核设施工作人员需要防护装备和定期监测，以限制其受到的辐射照射。

tip: 通常不可数；辐射不只指核辐射，也包括阳光。

senses.en: to a fairly good or satisfactory degree
in a sensible, fair, or logical way
at a fair and affordable price

ex.en: The kitchen is reasonably clean, but the floor needs sweeping.
ex.zh: 厨房还算干净，不过地板需要扫一扫。

ex.en: Public transport must be reasonably priced if cities want more residents to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 如果城市希望更多居民不开车出门，公共交通就必须定价合理。

tip: 表示程度时近于 fairly，并非 very。

senses.en: Organized resistance, often violent, against a government or ruler.
Refusal to accept authority, rules, or expected behaviour.

ex.en: Refusing to tidy his room was his small rebellion.
ex.zh: 拒绝整理房间是他小小的反抗。

ex.en: Historians often examine how economic hardship and political exclusion contribute to rebellion against established authority.
ex.zh: 历史学家常研究经济困境和政治排斥如何促成对既有权威的反抗。

tip: 常接against，说明反抗的对象。

senses.en: A device that receives radio, television, or other electronic signals.
The part of a telephone held to the ear and mouth.
A person who receives something.

ex.en: We adjusted the receiver until the music sounded clear.
ex.zh: 我们调试接收机，直到音乐听起来清晰为止。

ex.en: A satellite receiver can provide remote communities with access to educational broadcasts and emergency information.
ex.zh: 卫星接收器能让偏远社区收听收看教育节目，并获取紧急信息。

tip: receiver可指设备或人；收件人通常用recipient。

senses.en: A period when economic activity falls and many businesses struggle.
The gradual movement of something backwards from its previous position.

ex.en: During the recession, my uncle struggled to find work.
ex.zh: 经济衰退期间，我叔叔很难找到工作。

ex.en: Governments may increase public investment during a recession to protect jobs and stimulate consumer demand.
ex.zh: 政府可能在经济衰退期间增加公共投资，以保障就业并刺激消费需求。

tip: 通常指整体经济衰退，不等于单纯价格下跌。

senses.en: Say a poem or passage aloud, often from memory
Say a series of facts or details aloud

ex.en: My sister recited a short poem after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我妹妹背诵了一首短诗。

ex.en: Students who merely recite facts may struggle to apply their knowledge to unfamiliar problems.
ex.zh: 只会背诵事实的学生可能难以运用知识解决陌生的问题。

tip: recite强调出声背诵；memorise强调记住。

senses.en: Activities done for enjoyment and relaxation when not working.

ex.en: I swim for recreation at the local leisure centre.
ex.zh: 我在当地休闲中心游泳消遣。

ex.en: Access to green spaces encourages outdoor recreation and can improve both physical health and mental wellbeing.
ex.zh: 能够方便地使用绿地有助于鼓励户外休闲活动，并可改善身心健康。

tip: 表示休闲娱乐通常不可数；别与re-creation重新创造混淆。

senses.en: to find and employ workers or attract new members
someone who has recently joined an organization or armed force

ex.en: The animal shelter is recruiting volunteers for weekend shifts.
ex.zh: 这家动物收容所正在招募周末值班的志愿者。

ex.en: Hospitals need to recruit more nurses to meet the growing demand for healthcare services.
ex.zh: 医院需要招聘更多护士，以满足日益增长的医疗服务需求。

tip: recruit可作动词或可数名词；招聘活动用recruitment。

senses.en: an act of saying you will not do or accept something

ex.en: His polite refusal did not upset the host.
ex.zh: 他礼貌的谢绝并没有让主人不快。

ex.en: A government's refusal to address public concerns can weaken trust and reduce participation in democratic processes.
ex.zh: 政府拒绝处理公众关切可能削弱信任，并降低公众参与民主程序的意愿。

tip: 表示拒绝做某事，用refusal to do，不用of doing。

senses.en: The act of refusing to accept someone or something.
The body's immune response against transplanted tissue or an organ.

ex.en: After another rejection, she revised her job application.
ex.zh: 再次遭到拒绝后，她修改了自己的求职申请。

ex.en: Repeated rejection in the labour market can damage young people's confidence and discourage further job applications.
ex.zh: 在劳动力市场上屡遭拒绝，可能损害年轻人的信心，使他们不愿继续求职。

tip: rejection of后接被拒绝的人、提议或事物。

senses.en: a race in which teammates take turns completing sections
to pass information or broadcast signals to another person or place
an electrical switch controlled by another electrical circuit

ex.en: Our team dropped the baton during the school relay.
ex.zh: 我们队在学校接力赛中掉了接力棒。

ex.en: Emergency services relay weather warnings to remote communities through local radio stations and mobile networks.
ex.zh: 应急部门通过地方广播电台和移动网络向偏远社区传达天气警报。

tip: 动词也读/rɪˈleɪ/；relay a message指转达消息。

senses.en: The quality of working well or being worthy of trust.

ex.en: We chose this washing machine for its proven reliability.
ex.zh: 我们选择这台洗衣机，是因为它的可靠性经过了验证。

ex.en: Improving the reliability of public transport could encourage more commuters to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 提高公共交通的可靠性可以鼓励更多通勤者不开私家车出行。

tip: reliability通常不可数；形容词是reliable。

senses.en: what is left after other parts are removed or used
the amount left when division does not produce a whole number

ex.en: We ate half the cake and refrigerated the remainder.
ex.zh: 我们吃了半个蛋糕，把剩下的放进了冰箱。

ex.en: After funding essential services, the council allocated the remainder of its budget to improving public parks.
ex.zh: 在为基本服务拨款后，地方议会将剩余预算用于改善公共公园。

tip: 常用the remainder of；谓语单复数取决于所指内容。

senses.en: unusual or impressive enough to deserve special attention

ex.en: The injured bird made a remarkable recovery within weeks.
ex.zh: 这只受伤的鸟在几周内恢复得出奇地好。

ex.en: Recent advances in renewable energy demonstrate the remarkable potential of technology to reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 可再生能源领域的近期进展表明，技术在减少对化石燃料的依赖方面具有非凡潜力。

tip: 表示值得注意，常含赞赏，但不一定只描述好事。

senses.en: The act of taking something away from a place.
The act of dismissing someone from an official position.
The process of moving belongings to a new home.

ex.en: Stain removal is easier if you act quickly.
ex.zh: 污渍如果及时处理，就更容易去除。

ex.en: The removal of unnecessary packaging could significantly reduce the amount of household waste sent to landfill.
ex.zh: 去掉不必要的包装可以显著减少送往垃圾填埋场的生活垃圾。

tip: 搬家义主要用于英式英语；搬家公司为removal company。

senses.en: Naturally replaced and therefore available for continued use.
Able to be extended for another period of time.

ex.en: Our new solar panels provide renewable energy for the house.
ex.zh: 我们新装的太阳能板为房子提供可再生能源。

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy can create jobs while reducing a country's dependence on imported fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 投资可再生能源可以创造就业机会，同时减少一个国家对进口化石燃料的依赖。

tip: 名词renewables用复数，指可再生能源。

senses.en: the extension of an agreement or service for another period
the process of making something fresh, strong, or effective again

ex.en: My gym membership is due for renewal next month.
ex.zh: 我的健身房会员资格下个月该续期了。

ex.en: Urban renewal projects should improve public spaces without forcing existing residents to leave their neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 城市更新项目应改善公共空间，同时避免迫使现有居民搬离所在社区。

tip: renewal是名词；renew a subscription表示“续订”。

senses.en: to pay back money that you owe
to give something in return for help or kindness

ex.en: I will repay the money when I get paid.
ex.zh: 等发了工资，我就把钱还上。

ex.en: Graduates may struggle to repay their student loans if secure employment opportunities remain limited.
ex.zh: 如果稳定的就业机会仍然有限，毕业生可能难以偿还助学贷款。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为repaid；不表示报复。

senses.en: Many times, often with little time between occasions.

ex.en: He knocked repeatedly, but nobody came to the door.
ex.zh: 他敲了好几次门，但没人来开门。

ex.en: Students who repeatedly practise retrieving information tend to remember it better than those who simply reread their notes.
ex.zh: 反复练习回忆信息的学生，通常比只是重读笔记的学生记得更牢。

tip: 强调次数多；不一定像regularly那样有规律。

senses.en: similarity between people or things, especially in appearance

ex.en: There is a striking resemblance between the two sisters.
ex.zh: 这两姐妹长得非常像。

ex.en: Modern housing developments often bear little resemblance to traditional neighbourhoods, particularly in their layout and use of shared space.
ex.zh: 现代住宅开发项目往往与传统街区大不相同，尤其是在布局和公共空间的使用方面。

tip: resemblance to后接比较对象；resemble直接接宾语。

senses.en: A house or other place where someone lives.
The state or period of living in a particular place.

ex.en: Their new residence overlooks a quiet garden near the river.
ex.zh: 他们的新居俯瞰着河边一座安静的花园。

ex.en: Applicants may need to provide proof of residence before they can access certain local services.
ex.zh: 申请人可能需要提供居住证明，才能使用某些地方服务。

tip: residence较正式；居民是resident，住宅区用residential。

senses.en: To officially leave a job or position.

senses.zh: 使自己接受不如意的事
senses.en: To accept an unpleasant situation because you cannot change it.

ex.en: She decided to resign and open a small bakery.
ex.zh: 她决定辞职，开一家小面包店。

ex.en: Employees may resign when excessive workloads and limited career opportunities make their positions increasingly difficult to sustain.
ex.zh: 当工作量过大、职业发展机会有限，使岗位越来越难以维持时，员工可能会辞职。

tip: resign oneself to后接名词或动名词，表示无奈接受。

senses.en: Belonging separately to each person or thing already mentioned.

ex.en: After dinner, the children returned to their respective rooms.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，孩子们各自回了自己的房间。

ex.en: Schools and families should understand their respective responsibilities in supporting children's emotional development and academic progress.
ex.zh: 学校和家庭应了解各自在支持儿童情感发展和学业进步方面的责任。

tip: 通常放在复数名词前；勿与respectful混淆。

senses.en: limited in amount, range, or freedom
available or open only to people with permission

ex.en: Parking is restricted here during the busy morning hours.
ex.zh: 早晨繁忙时段，这里限制停车。

ex.en: Restricted access to affordable healthcare can worsen existing inequalities between wealthy communities and disadvantaged rural populations.
ex.zh: 获得平价医疗服务的机会受限，会加剧富裕社区与弱势农村人口之间已有的不平等。

tip: restricted to表示“仅限于”；也是restrict过去分词。

senses.en: The area of land beside a river.

ex.en: We walked along the riverside after a late lunch.
ex.zh: 我们吃过午饭后，沿着河边散步。

ex.en: Improving access to the riverside can create attractive public spaces and encourage residents to exercise outdoors.
ex.zh: 改善通往河畔的通道可以打造宜人的公共空间，鼓励居民进行户外锻炼。

tip: 常作名词定语，如 a riverside park（河滨公园）。

senses.en: Movement around a central point or axis
The regular replacement of one thing or person by another

ex.en: The wheel completed one rotation before stopping in the mud.
ex.zh: 车轮转了一圈后便停在了泥里。

ex.en: Crop rotation helps farmers maintain soil fertility and reduce their reliance on chemical pesticides.
ex.zh: 作物轮作有助于农民保持土壤肥力，并减少对化学农药的依赖。

tip: rotation 可指绕轴旋转，也可指按顺序轮换。

senses.en: Having political power over a country or group
An official decision made by a judge or authority

ex.en: The ruling party promised to improve our local buses.
ex.zh: 执政党承诺改善我们当地的公交服务。

ex.en: A recent court ruling requires employers to provide clearer information about working hours and holiday entitlement.
ex.zh: 法院最近的一项裁决要求雇主更清楚地说明工作时间和休假权利。

tip: 作形容词通常放在名词前；作名词指正式裁决。

senses.en: Connected with religion and deserving deep respect
Considered too important or valuable to change or harm

ex.en: Visitors remove their shoes before entering the sacred temple.
ex.zh: 游客进入这座神圣的寺庙前会脱鞋。

ex.en: Tourism can support local economies, but visitors must respect sacred places and religious customs.
ex.zh: 旅游业可以促进当地经济，但游客必须尊重圣地和宗教习俗。

tip: sacred可指宗教上的神圣，也指极珍视、不可侵犯。

senses.en: a seat on a horse or bicycle
to put a saddle on a horse
to give someone an unwanted responsibility or burden

ex.en: I lowered the saddle before riding my new bicycle.
ex.zh: 骑新自行车之前，我把车座调低了。

ex.en: Excessive university fees can saddle graduates with debts that limit their career choices for many years.
ex.zh: 过高的大学学费可能让毕业生背负债务，多年来限制他们的职业选择。

tip: saddle someone with指使某人承担不想要的负担。

senses.en: To show respect through a formal gesture, especially in the military.
To publicly express admiration for someone or their achievements.
A formal gesture or action showing respect.

ex.en: The officer raised her hand to salute the captain.
ex.zh: 那位军官抬手向上尉敬礼。

ex.en: Public ceremonies can salute the contributions of volunteers while encouraging more citizens to participate in community projects.
ex.zh: 公共仪式可以表彰志愿者的贡献，同时鼓励更多公民参与社区项目。

tip: 作动词直接接人：salute someone，无需加to。

senses.en: A device orbiting Earth or another body, collecting or transmitting information.
A natural object that moves around a planet.

ex.en: The satellite sent back clear pictures of the storm.
ex.zh: 这颗卫星传回了风暴的清晰图像。

ex.en: Satellite observations allow scientists to monitor changes in forest cover across remote regions over time.
ex.zh: 卫星观测使科学家能够长期监测偏远地区森林覆盖的变化。

tip: 可指人造或天然卫星；月球是地球的天然卫星。

senses.en: in a way that meets expectations or requirements

ex.en: The washing machine worked satisfactorily after the repair.
ex.zh: 修理之后，洗衣机运转正常，令人满意。

ex.en: Public transport cannot function satisfactorily unless local authorities invest in regular maintenance and staff training.
ex.zh: 除非地方政府投入资金进行定期维护和员工培训，否则公共交通无法良好运转。

tip: 表示达到要求，不一定是表现出色。

senses.en: Good enough to meet a particular need or standard

ex.en: The mechanic confirmed that the brakes were satisfactory.
ex.zh: 修理工确认刹车状况合格。
