ex.en: Providing satisfactory public transport is essential if cities want residents to rely less on private cars.
ex.zh: 城市若希望居民减少对私家车的依赖，就必须提供令人满意的公共交通服务。

tip: 强调达到要求，不一定出色；人的满意感用satisfied。

senses.en: not available in large enough amounts to meet demand

ex.en: Fresh vegetables became scarce after snow blocked the roads.
ex.zh: 大雪封路后，新鲜蔬菜变得紧缺。

ex.en: As clean water becomes increasingly scarce, governments must invest in efficient irrigation and better water management systems.
ex.zh: 随着清洁水源日益短缺，政府必须投资于高效灌溉和更完善的水资源管理系统。

tip: scarce指供应不足；rare强调少见，不一定短缺。

senses.en: Almost not, or only just
Only a very short time before something else happens

ex.en: We could scarcely hear each other above the music.
ex.zh: 音乐声太大，我们几乎听不清彼此说话。

ex.en: Some rural communities have scarcely enough medical staff to provide basic healthcare for their growing populations.
ex.zh: 一些农村社区的医务人员仅勉强够为日益增长的人口提供基本医疗服务。

tip: 本身含否定意义，不再加not；scarcely…when指刚…就…。

senses.en: To speak angrily to someone because they did something wrong.

ex.en: Dad scolded me for leaving the freezer door open.
ex.zh: 爸爸因为我没关冰柜门而训了我。

ex.en: Teachers who frequently scold pupils may discourage them from asking questions and participating in classroom discussions.
ex.zh: 经常训斥学生的教师可能会使学生不愿提问或参与课堂讨论。

col: 因某人做某事而训斥他
tip: 用 scold someone for doing，表示因某行为责骂某人。

senses.en: The range of subjects or activities that something covers.
The opportunity or freedom to do or develop something.

ex.en: Kitchen repairs fall outside the scope of this job.
ex.zh: 厨房维修不属于这项工作的范围。

ex.en: The scope of the study was limited to urban schools, so its findings may not apply to rural communities.
ex.zh: 该研究仅涉及城市学校，因此其结论未必适用于农村社区。

tip: 范围用scope of；做某事的余地用scope for。

senses.en: Someone sent to gather information or discover talented people.
To search an area for something or gather information.
A member of a youth group learning outdoor skills.

ex.en: A scout watched our team practise after school.
ex.zh: 放学后，一位球探观看了我们队的训练。

ex.en: Sports clubs often scout for talented young players in communities that lack access to professional training facilities.
ex.zh: 体育俱乐部经常到缺乏专业训练设施的社区寻找有天赋的年轻球员。

tip: scout for后接寻找的对象；童子军成员常写作Scout。

senses.en: A coastal harbour or town where ships load and unload.

ex.en: Huge ships arrive at the seaport every morning.
ex.zh: 每天早晨都有巨轮抵达这个海港。

ex.en: Investment in modern seaports can strengthen international trade and create employment in coastal regions.
ex.zh: 投资建设现代化海港可以促进国际贸易，并在沿海地区创造就业机会。

tip: seaport强调海港，区别于内河港和机场。

senses.en: Not often; on very few occasions.

ex.en: We seldom eat out because we enjoy cooking together.
ex.zh: 我们很少外出吃饭，因为我们喜欢一起做饭。

ex.en: Rural communities seldom receive the same level of public transport investment as major urban centres.
ex.zh: 农村社区很少获得与主要城市中心同等水平的公共交通投资。

tip: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；置于句首常需倒装。

senses.en: protecting yourself from attack or physical harm

ex.en: My sister attends a self-defence class every Saturday.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每周六都上自卫术课。

ex.en: Self-defence courses can build confidence, although avoiding dangerous situations should remain the primary focus of personal safety.
ex.zh: 自卫课程能增强信心，但人身安全仍应以避免危险处境为首要重点。

tip: 通常不可数；美式拼写为self-defense。

senses.en: Working for yourself rather than being employed by an organisation.

ex.en: My aunt is a self-employed electrician with her own van.
ex.zh: 我姑姑是个体电工，有自己的货车。

ex.en: Self-employed workers often enjoy flexible schedules but may lack paid holidays and a stable monthly income.
ex.zh: 自雇者通常享有灵活的工作时间，但可能没有带薪假期和稳定的月收入。

tip: 指为自己工作，不等于失业；注意保留连字符。

senses.en: working for yourself rather than for an employer

ex.en: Self-employment lets me choose when I take holidays.
ex.zh: 自雇让我可以自己决定什么时候休假。

ex.en: Although self-employment offers greater flexibility, it can also involve irregular income and limited access to employment benefits.
ex.zh: 虽然自雇更灵活，但也可能意味着收入不稳定，且难以享有雇员福利。

tip: 不可数；指为自己工作，不一定是创办公司。

senses.en: An agreement that ends a dispute.
A place where people establish a community.
The payment of money owed.

ex.en: The neighbours finally reached a settlement over the damaged fence.
ex.zh: 邻居们终于就受损围栏的问题达成了和解。

ex.en: Ancient settlements often developed near rivers because reliable water supplies supported farming, trade, and daily life.
ex.zh: 古代聚居地往往形成于河流附近，因为可靠的水源能支持农业、贸易和日常生活。

tip: 可指争议的解决协议，也可指人们居住的定居点。

senses.en: Wastewater and human waste carried away through drains

ex.en: Untreated sewage flowed into the river after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨过后，未经处理的污水流入了河里。

ex.en: Investing in modern sewage treatment facilities is essential for protecting freshwater ecosystems and maintaining public health.
ex.zh: 投资建设现代污水处理设施，对保护淡水生态系统和维护公共卫生至关重要。

tip: 不可数；sewage是污水，sewer才是下水道。

senses.en: Protected from direct sunlight.
Made darker with colour or drawn marks.

ex.en: We found a shaded bench beneath an old tree.
ex.zh: 我们在一棵老树下找到了一张背阴的长椅。

ex.en: Providing shaded areas in public parks encourages outdoor activity during hot weather and reduces heat exposure.
ex.zh: 在公园提供遮阴区域，有助于鼓励人们在炎热天气进行户外活动，并减少高温暴露。

tip: 也可作shade的过去式或过去分词，表示遮挡阳光。

senses.en: An object that protects someone or something from harm.
To protect someone or something from harm or exposure.

ex.en: The worker lowered a clear shield over her face.
ex.zh: 这名工人放下透明面罩，护住脸部。

ex.en: Urban trees can shield pedestrians from intense sunlight while reducing temperatures in densely populated neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 城市树木能为行人遮挡强烈阳光，同时降低人口密集街区的温度。

tip: 动词常用shield someone from something。

senses.en: lasting or having effects for only a limited time

ex.en: This short-term job will cover my summer expenses.
ex.zh: 这份短期工作能支付我暑假期间的开销。

ex.en: Short-term solutions may reduce immediate pressure but fail to address the underlying causes of unemployment.
ex.zh: 短期措施或许能缓解眼前的压力，却无法解决失业的根本原因。

tip: 作定语常用连字符；in the short term不加。

senses.en: A movable panel that covers and protects a window
A camera mechanism controlling how long light enters
To close a building or business, temporarily or permanently

ex.en: I closed the wooden shutters before the storm arrived.
ex.zh: 暴风雨来临前，我关上了木制窗板。

ex.en: Photographers use a fast shutter speed to capture moving wildlife clearly without disturbing its natural behaviour.
ex.zh: 摄影师使用较快的快门速度，在不干扰野生动物自然行为的情况下清晰捕捉其动态。

tip: 窗板常用复数shutters；快门速度用shutter speed。

senses.zh: 短程往返接驳交通工具
senses.en: a vehicle making frequent trips between two places
a spacecraft designed for repeated journeys into space
to travel or carry people repeatedly between places

ex.en: We took the free shuttle from the airport to our hotel.
ex.zh: 我们从机场乘免费接驳车去了酒店。

ex.en: Regular shuttle services between railway stations and business parks could reduce dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 火车站与商业园区之间的定期接驳服务可以减少人们对私家车的依赖。

tip: 交通语境中强调两地间往返；航天飞机用space shuttle。

senses.en: A roadside post showing directions to different places.
Mark a route or place with signs showing directions.
Make the structure or direction of an explanation clear.

ex.en: We stopped at the signpost beside the forest path.
ex.zh: 我们在林间小路旁的路标处停了下来。

ex.en: Writers should signpost changes in their argument so that readers can follow complex discussions more easily.
ex.zh: 作者应提示论证中的转折，让读者更容易跟上复杂的讨论。

tip: 写作中作动词，指用衔接表达提示论证结构。

senses.en: the practice of keeping skin clean, healthy, and protected

ex.en: My daily skincare routine includes washing gently and applying moisturiser.
ex.zh: 我每天的护肤步骤包括温和清洁和涂保湿霜。

ex.en: Public health campaigns can promote sensible skincare habits, including regular sun protection and avoiding irritating products.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传可以推广合理的护肤习惯，包括经常采取防晒措施和避免使用刺激性产品。

tip: 通常不可数；也可写成两个词skin care。

senses.en: The feeling of being tired and wanting to sleep.

ex.en: A short walk helped me shake off my sleepiness.
ex.zh: 散了一小会儿步后，我驱散了困意。

ex.en: Persistent daytime sleepiness can affect students' concentration and reduce their ability to absorb new information.
ex.zh: 白天持续困倦会影响学生的注意力，降低他们吸收新信息的能力。

tip: 不可数名词，指想睡的感觉，不等于已经入睡。

senses.en: a poor urban area with overcrowded housing in bad condition

ex.en: Their family shared a small room in a crowded slum.
ex.zh: 他们一家挤住在拥挤贫民窟里的一间小屋中。

ex.en: Improving sanitation and access to clean water can significantly reduce disease in densely populated slums.
ex.zh: 改善卫生设施和清洁水源的获取条件，可以显著减少人口密集的贫民窟中的疾病。

tip: 指居住条件差的城区，不等于所有低收入社区。

senses.en: Polluted air forming a thick cloud over an area.

ex.en: Thick smog hid the hills beyond our apartment.
ex.zh: 浓重的雾霾遮住了我们公寓远处的山丘。

ex.en: Reducing vehicle emissions can help cities tackle smog and protect residents from respiratory diseases.
ex.zh: 减少机动车排放有助于城市治理雾霾，保护居民免受呼吸系统疾病的侵害。

tip: 通常不可数；smog指污染性烟雾，不是普通雾。

senses.en: To move goods or people secretly and against the rules.

ex.en: Someone tried to smuggle rare birds through the airport.
ex.zh: 有人试图通过机场偷运珍稀鸟类。

ex.en: Stronger international cooperation is needed to stop criminal groups that smuggle endangered animals across national borders.
ex.zh: 需要加强国际合作，以阻止跨境走私濒危动物的犯罪团伙。

tip: 常用smuggle sth into/out of某地，表示偷运进出。

senses.en: Described a certain way, though that description may be doubtful.
Known by a particular name or term.

ex.en: This so-called waterproof jacket let the rain straight through.
ex.zh: 这件号称防水的夹克竟让雨水直接渗了进来。

ex.en: Consumers should examine whether so-called green products actually reduce environmental harm throughout their life cycle.
ex.zh: 消费者应审视所谓的绿色产品是否确实在整个生命周期内减少环境危害。

tip: 置于名词前，常含质疑，但也可中性引出名称。

senses.en: to increase quickly to a very high level
to fly high in the air, often without moving wings

ex.en: Electricity bills soared during the unusually cold winter.
ex.zh: 在那个异常寒冷的冬天，电费猛涨。

ex.en: Housing prices may soar when population growth exceeds the supply of affordable homes in major cities.
ex.zh: 当人口增长超过大城市经济适用住房的供应能力时，房价可能飙升。

tip: 表示价格等猛涨时为不及物动词，不直接接宾语。

senses.en: to cry with short, sudden breaths
a short, broken breath or sound made while crying

ex.en: The child began to sob after losing her toy.
ex.zh: 孩子丢了玩具后开始抽泣。

ex.en: Children may sob when separated from caregivers, so schools should provide gentle support during transitions.
ex.zh: 儿童与照顾者分开时可能会抽泣，因此学校应在适应阶段给予温和的支持。

tip: 过去式sobbed，进行式sobbing，均双写b。

senses.en: A political and economic system favouring public ownership of productive resources

ex.en: Our history teacher explained socialism during today's lively class discussion.
ex.zh: 在今天热烈的课堂讨论中，我们的历史老师讲解了社会主义。

ex.en: Debates about socialism often focus on public ownership, economic equality, and the appropriate role of government.
ex.zh: 关于社会主义的讨论往往聚焦于公有制、经济平等以及政府应发挥的作用。

tip: 通常为不可数名词；socialist可指社会主义者。

senses.en: highly developed and involving complex methods or technology

senses.zh: 见多识广的；品位高雅的
senses.en: knowledgeable about culture and confident in social situations

ex.en: This sophisticated camera adjusts its settings automatically in low light.
ex.zh: 这台先进的相机会在光线不足时自动调整设置。

ex.en: Sophisticated monitoring systems allow researchers to detect small changes in air quality across densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 先进的监测系统使研究人员能够发现人口密集城市中空气质量的细微变化。

tip: 形容设备指精密先进；形容人可指见多识广。

senses.en: The recorded music, speech, and sounds accompanying a film or programme.

ex.en: I listened to the film's soundtrack on the bus.
ex.zh: 我在公交车上听了那部电影的原声音乐。

ex.en: A carefully chosen soundtrack can strengthen a documentary's emotional impact without distracting viewers from its central message.
ex.zh: 精心挑选的配乐可以增强纪录片的情感感染力，又不分散观众对核心信息的注意力。

tip: 不仅指配乐，也可指含对白和音效的完整声轨。

senses.en: towards the south
moving or pointing towards the south

ex.en: We drove southward until we reached the coast.
ex.zh: 我们一直向南开车，直到抵达海岸。

ex.en: The southward movement of some marine species may reflect changes in ocean temperatures and food availability.
ex.zh: 一些海洋物种向南迁移，可能反映了海水温度和食物供应的变化。

tip: southward兼作形容词和副词；southwards仅作副词。

senses.en: Relating to the former Soviet Union or its governing councils.
A citizen of the former Soviet Union.

ex.en: My grandfather kept a Soviet camera in this drawer.
ex.zh: 我祖父在这个抽屉里存放过一台苏联相机。

ex.en: Researchers study Soviet housing policies to understand how central planning influenced urban development and everyday life.
ex.zh: 研究人员通过考察苏联的住房政策，了解中央计划如何影响城市发展和日常生活。

tip: Soviet通常大写；小写soviet可指苏维埃议会。

senses.en: Designed for a particular purpose or requiring specific expert knowledge.

ex.en: The mechanic used specialised tools to repair my bicycle.
ex.zh: 修理工用专用工具修好了我的自行车。

ex.en: Hospitals need specialised equipment and trained staff to provide effective treatment for patients with complex conditions.
ex.zh: 医院需要专用设备和受过训练的人员，才能为病情复杂的患者提供有效治疗。

tip: 英式常用specialised，美式常用specialized。

senses.en: Someone who watches an event, especially a sporting event.

ex.en: A spectator caught the ball near the fence.
ex.zh: 一名观众在围栏附近接住了球。

ex.en: Major sporting events attract thousands of spectators and can generate substantial income for local businesses.
ex.zh: 大型体育赛事吸引成千上万的观众，并能为当地商家带来可观收入。

tip: 常指体育赛事现场观众；演出观众多用audience。

senses.en: Form ideas about something without having enough evidence.
Buy and sell assets hoping to profit from price changes.

ex.en: We can only speculate about what caused the delay.
ex.zh: 我们只能猜测延误的原因。

ex.en: Researchers speculate that changing work patterns could reduce traffic congestion in major urban centres.
ex.zh: 研究人员推测，工作模式的改变可能缓解大城市中心的交通拥堵。

tip: 推测常接about或that从句；投机领域用in。

senses.en: Ideas about something without enough evidence to be certain.
Risky buying and selling intended to produce quick profits.

ex.en: The empty shop has sparked speculation among our neighbours.
ex.zh: 那间空置店铺引发了邻居们的种种猜测。

ex.en: Property speculation can drive housing prices beyond local incomes, making it harder for young adults to buy homes.
ex.zh: 房地产投机可能推动房价涨至当地收入难以负担的水平，使年轻人更难买房。

tip: 猜测内容常接about或that从句；也可指金融投机。

senses.en: A man who speaks officially for a group or organisation

ex.en: A spokesman explained why the swimming pool was closed.
ex.zh: 一位男发言人解释了游泳池关闭的原因。

ex.en: The government spokesman announced that additional funding would support public transport improvements in rural communities.
ex.zh: 政府男发言人宣布，将追加资金支持农村地区的公共交通改善。

tip: 特指男性；不强调性别时用spokesperson。

senses.en: Financial support for an activity, often in exchange for publicity.

ex.en: Our swimming club needs sponsorship to buy new equipment.
ex.zh: 我们的游泳俱乐部需要赞助来购买新器材。

ex.en: Corporate sponsorship allows many cultural festivals to remain affordable, although it may influence their artistic choices.
ex.zh: 企业赞助让许多文化节保持亲民价格，但也可能影响其艺术选择。

tip: 核心是提供资金等支持，并不等于主办活动。

senses.en: make or become steady and less likely to change

ex.en: We used a wooden block to stabilize the table.
ex.zh: 我们用一块木块让桌子保持平稳。

ex.en: Governments may need to stabilize food prices to protect vulnerable households during periods of economic uncertainty.
ex.zh: 在经济不确定时期，政府可能需要稳定食品价格，以保护弱势家庭。

tip: 可及物也可不及物；英式英语也常拼作stabilise。

senses.en: To suddenly surprise or frighten someone

ex.en: The sudden knock startled me while I was cooking.
ex.zh: 我做饭时，突然的敲门声吓了我一跳。

ex.en: Loud construction noises can startle nearby wildlife and disrupt their feeding patterns during the breeding season.
ex.zh: 繁殖季节，巨大的施工噪声会惊吓附近的野生动物，扰乱它们的觅食规律。

tip: 强调突然受惊，不等于长期感到害怕。

senses.en: not moving, changing, or developing
relating to electric charges that build up on surfaces
electrical interference or an electric charge collected on a surface

ex.en: The television picture stayed static while the sound continued.
ex.zh: 电视画面停住不动了，但声音还在继续。

ex.en: Wages have remained static for several years, while housing costs have risen steadily in major cities.
ex.zh: 工资多年来一直没有变化，而大城市的住房成本却持续上涨。

tip: static强调不动或不变；静电用static electricity。

senses.en: relating to collecting, studying, or interpreting numerical data

ex.en: She used statistical software to compare the survey results.
ex.zh: 她用统计软件比较了调查结果。

ex.en: Reliable statistical evidence helps governments identify communities that need better access to healthcare.
ex.zh: 可靠的统计证据有助于政府确定哪些社区需要更便利的医疗服务。

tip: statistical指与统计有关，不等于“显著的”。

senses.en: to encourage something to develop or become more active
to make a body part or biological process more active

ex.en: These colourful puzzles stimulate my daughter's curiosity every morning.
ex.zh: 这些色彩鲜艳的拼图每天早上都能激发我女儿的好奇心。

ex.en: Lower borrowing costs can stimulate economic growth by encouraging businesses to invest in new equipment.
ex.zh: 降低借贷成本可以鼓励企业投资新设备，从而促进经济增长。

tip: 直接接宾语：stimulate interest表示激发兴趣。

senses.en: Cause sharp pain with a pointed body part or irritating substance
A painful insect injury or a sudden sharp pain
Make someone feel suddenly upset or hurt

ex.en: A bee stung my ankle while I watered the flowers.
ex.zh: 我浇花时，一只蜜蜂蜇了我的脚踝。

ex.en: Harsh criticism can sting young learners and discourage them from participating in classroom discussions.
ex.zh: 严厉的批评会伤害年幼学习者的感情，使他们不愿参与课堂讨论。

tip: 过去式、过去分词均为stung；蜇用sting，咬用bite。

senses.en: enough to meet a need or achieve a purpose

ex.en: We have sufficient food for everyone at the picnic.
ex.zh: 我们准备了足够的食物，供参加野餐的每个人享用。

ex.en: Without sufficient funding, local authorities may struggle to maintain essential services for their growing populations.
ex.zh: 如果资金不足，地方政府可能难以为不断增长的人口维持基本服务。

tip: 常用sufficient for或sufficient to do，语气较正式。

senses.en: to the degree needed for a particular purpose

ex.en: The soup had cooled sufficiently for us to eat.
ex.zh: 汤已经凉到我们可以喝的程度了。

ex.en: Public transport must be sufficiently reliable to persuade commuters to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 公共交通必须足够可靠，才能说服通勤者不开私家车出行。

tip: 修饰形容词时放在其前；enough则放在其后。

senses.en: a yellow chemical element used in industry and agriculture

ex.en: The guide showed us yellow sulphur near the volcano.
ex.zh: 导游给我们看了火山附近黄色的硫磺。

ex.en: Burning fuels containing sulphur releases gases that contribute to acid rain and damage natural ecosystems.
ex.zh: 燃烧含硫燃料会释放促成酸雨的气体，破坏自然生态系统。

tip: sulphur是传统英式拼写；科学文献常用sulfur。

senses.en: an object that blocks sunlight to provide shade

ex.en: We opened the sunshade above our garden table.
ex.zh: 我们撑开了花园桌子上方的遮阳伞。

ex.en: Installing a sunshade over each outdoor seating area can make public spaces more comfortable in summer.
ex.zh: 在每处户外座椅区上方安装遮阳设施，可以让公共空间在夏季更加舒适。

tip: sunshade用于遮阳；umbrella通常指雨伞。

senses.en: Extremely good in quality or performance.

ex.en: We enjoyed a superb meal overlooking the quiet harbour.
ex.zh: 我们一边俯瞰宁静的港湾，一边享用了一顿极棒的饭菜。

ex.en: The museum offers superb educational facilities, allowing visitors of all ages to explore scientific ideas through practical activities.
ex.zh: 这家博物馆提供一流的教育设施，让各年龄段的参观者通过实践活动探索科学概念。

tip: 本身已含程度很高之意，通常不说very superb。

senses.en: a person or company that provides goods or services

ex.en: Our bakery gets fresh flour from a local supplier.
ex.zh: 我们面包店从一家本地供应商那里购买新鲜面粉。

ex.en: Businesses should assess each supplier carefully to ensure that materials are produced under fair working conditions.
ex.zh: 企业应仔细评估每一家供应商，确保原材料在公平的劳动条件下生产。

tip: supplier of后接所供物品；supply为其动词形式。

senses.en: used to introduce an imagined situation or possibility

ex.en: Supposing the bus is late, can we walk instead?
ex.zh: 假如公交车晚点，我们能改为步行吗？

ex.en: Supposing that university education became free, how would governments cover the additional costs without reducing other essential services?
ex.zh: 假如大学教育免费，政府如何在不削减其他基本服务的情况下承担额外费用？

tip: 相当于if，可接that从句，常用来提出假设。

senses.en: a long orchestral composition, usually divided into several movements

ex.en: We listened to a symphony while cooking dinner.
ex.zh: 我们做晚饭时听了一首交响曲。

ex.en: Performing a symphony requires close cooperation among musicians, demonstrating the importance of teamwork in the arts.
ex.zh: 演奏交响曲需要音乐家之间密切合作，体现了团队协作在艺术中的重要性。

tip: symphony指交响曲；交响乐团用symphony orchestra。

senses.en: Following an organised plan or method rather than acting randomly.

ex.en: Her systematic packing made everything easy to find later.
ex.zh: 她收拾行李很有条理，之后什么都很容易找到。

ex.en: A systematic review of existing research can help governments develop more effective public health policies.
ex.zh: 对现有研究进行系统综述，有助于政府制定更有效的公共卫生政策。

tip: systematic指有条理；systemic指系统整体的。

senses.en: Specific methods used to achieve a goal or gain an advantage.

ex.en: Our coach changed tactics halfway through the football match.
ex.zh: 足球比赛进行到一半时，我们的教练改变了战术。

ex.en: Companies increasingly use digital marketing tactics to attract younger consumers and compete in crowded markets.
ex.zh: 企业越来越多地采用数字营销策略来吸引年轻消费者，并在竞争激烈的市场中争得优势。

tip: strategy侧重整体战略，tactics侧重具体手段。

senses.en: Used to people and not wild or dangerous.
To train a wild animal or bring something under control.
Not exciting, adventurous, or impressive.

ex.en: The tame rabbit ate directly from my hand.
ex.zh: 那只温顺的兔子直接吃我手里的食物。

ex.en: Even tame animals require careful handling, especially when young children are learning to interact with them.
ex.zh: 即使是驯服的动物也需要谨慎对待，尤其是在幼儿学习与它们互动时。

tip: tame指不怕人或被驯服，不等于天生无害。

senses.en: A ship designed to carry large quantities of liquid
A road vehicle carrying liquids or gases in a large tank

ex.en: We watched a huge tanker sail into the harbour.
ex.zh: 我们看着一艘巨大的油轮驶入港口。

ex.en: An accident involving an oil tanker can cause lasting damage to coastal ecosystems.
ex.zh: 涉及油轮的事故可能对沿海生态系统造成持久损害。

tip: tank可指储罐；tanker指运输液体等的船或车辆。

senses.en: A person or organisation that pays taxes.

ex.en: As a taxpayer, I want cleaner streets and safer parks.
ex.zh: 作为纳税人，我希望街道更干净，公园更安全。

ex.en: Public infrastructure projects should deliver lasting benefits to the taxpayers who finance them.
ex.zh: 公共基础设施项目应为出资的纳税人带来持久的益处。

tip: 通常指纳税的个人，也可指纳税机构。

senses.en: A strong desire for something, or something causing that desire.

ex.en: I resisted the temptation to eat another slice of cake.
ex.zh: 我忍住了再吃一块蛋糕的诱惑。

ex.en: Students may face the temptation to copy online material rather than develop their own ideas.
ex.zh: 学生可能会受到诱惑，抄袭网上的材料，而不是形成自己的观点。

tip: 常用the temptation to do，表示想做某事的诱惑。

senses.en: someone who pays rent to use property or land

ex.en: The new tenant brought plants for the balcony.
ex.zh: 新房客带来了几盆植物，准备放在阳台上。

ex.en: Clear rental agreements protect both the tenant and the landlord by defining their responsibilities.
ex.zh: 明确的租赁协议通过界定双方责任，保障房客和房东的权益。

tip: tenant是租客，landlord是房东，二者是对应角色。

senses.en: An extremely strong feeling of fear.
Violence or threats used to frighten and control people.

ex.en: She woke in terror after dreaming about a falling lift.
ex.zh: 她梦见电梯坠落，惊恐地醒了过来。

ex.en: Responsible news reporting should inform the public about threats without spreading unnecessary terror among communities.
ex.zh: 负责任的新闻报道应向公众说明威胁，同时避免在社区中传播不必要的恐慌。

tip: 表示强烈恐惧，程度比fear深；通常不可数。

senses.en: cloth made by weaving, knitting, or other fibre processing
relating to cloth or its production

ex.en: The market stall sells colourful textiles for making curtains.
ex.zh: 这个市场摊位出售用来做窗帘的彩色织物。

ex.en: The textile industry can reduce water pollution by adopting cleaner production methods and treating wastewater effectively.
ex.zh: 纺织业可以采用更清洁的生产方式并有效处理废水，从而减少水污染。

tip: 表示各类纺织品时常用复数textiles。

senses.en: wood prepared for building or making things
trees grown for wood used in construction or manufacturing

ex.en: The carpenter stacked the timber beside the workshop.
ex.zh: 木匠把木料堆在了工坊旁边。

ex.en: Using responsibly sourced timber in construction can reduce environmental damage while supporting sustainable forest management.
ex.zh: 在建筑中使用来源负责任的木材，既能减少环境破坏，也能支持可持续森林管理。

tip: 指木材时通常不可数；美式英语常用lumber指加工木料。

senses.en: taking a lot of time to do or complete

ex.en: Sorting all these old photos is surprisingly time-consuming.
ex.zh: 整理这些旧照片竟然这么费时间。

ex.en: Applying for multiple permits can be time-consuming, discouraging small businesses from expanding their operations.
ex.zh: 申请多项许可可能很耗时，使小企业不愿扩大经营规模。

tip: 强调花费大量时间，不一定表示浪费时间。

senses.en: A legally protected name or symbol identifying a company's products.
A distinctive feature strongly associated with someone or something.
To register a name or symbol for legal protection.

ex.en: The bakery's trademark is a tiny golden wheat stalk.
ex.zh: 这家面包店的商标是一株小小的金色麦穗。

ex.en: Registering a trademark helps small businesses protect their identity and distinguish their products from those of competitors.
ex.zh: 注册商标有助于小企业保护自身品牌形象，并使其产品区别于竞争对手的产品。

tip: 商标用trademark；版权用copyright，保护对象不同。

senses.en: a formal agreement between countries

ex.en: We heard about the new treaty on the radio.
ex.zh: 我们从广播中听说了这项新条约。

ex.en: An international treaty can establish shared environmental standards, but its success depends on effective enforcement.
ex.zh: 国际条约可以确立共同的环境标准，但其成功取决于有效执行。

tip: 通常指国家间正式协议，不表示谈判过程。

senses.en: An important victory or impressive achievement.
Great happiness and pride after achieving success.
To achieve victory or overcome a difficulty.

ex.en: Winning the local chess tournament was a triumph for Amir.
ex.zh: 赢得当地国际象棋锦标赛对阿米尔来说是一次重大胜利。

ex.en: The successful restoration of the wetland represents a triumph for conservation groups and local residents.
ex.zh: 湿地的成功修复是环保团体和当地居民取得的一项重大成果。

tip: 作动词时常用triumph over，表示战胜。

senses.en: Too expensive for someone to pay for.

ex.en: The larger flat was unaffordable on my salary.
ex.zh: 以我的工资，负担不起那套更大的公寓。

ex.en: When housing becomes unaffordable, essential workers may be forced to move far from their workplaces.
ex.zh: 当住房变得难以负担时，关键岗位工作人员可能被迫搬到离工作地点很远的地方。

tip: 强调超出支付能力，不只是价格高。

senses.en: to experience a process, change, or treatment

ex.en: My uncle will undergo knee surgery early next week.
ex.zh: 我叔叔下周初将接受膝盖手术。

ex.en: Many coastal cities will undergo significant changes as rising sea levels force governments to reconsider urban planning.
ex.zh: 随着海平面上升迫使政府重新考虑城市规划，许多沿海城市将经历重大变化。

tip: 过去式underwent，过去分词undergone；直接接宾语。

senses.en: Located or happening below the surface of the sea

ex.en: The documentary showed colourful fish around an undersea cave.
ex.zh: 这部纪录片展示了海底洞穴周围色彩斑斓的鱼。

ex.en: Undersea cables connect continents and provide essential infrastructure for global communication and international trade.
ex.zh: 海底电缆连接各大洲，为全球通信和国际贸易提供重要基础设施。

tip: 常放在名词前；强调海面以下，而非所有水下环境。

senses.en: Accept responsibility for a task and begin doing it
Promise to do something

ex.en: We undertook the repairs ourselves to save money.
ex.zh: 我们自己动手维修，以节省开支。

ex.en: Universities should undertake further research before recommending major changes to national education policy.
ex.zh: 大学应在建议对国家教育政策作重大调整之前开展进一步研究。

tip: 过去式undertook，过去分词undertaken。

senses.en: Certainly true, with no reasonable doubt.

ex.en: This is undoubtedly the warmest coat I have ever owned.
ex.zh: 这无疑是我穿过的最暖和的外套。

ex.en: Access to clean drinking water undoubtedly improves public health, particularly in communities with limited medical services.
ex.zh: 获得清洁饮用水无疑能改善公共健康，尤其是在医疗服务有限的社区。

tip: 语气很肯定；证据不足时宜用probably等弱化表达。

senses.en: not level, flat, or smooth
not equal or regular in amount, quality, or distribution

ex.en: Watch your step on the uneven stones outside.
ex.zh: 外面的石头高低不平，走路时要小心。

ex.en: Uneven access to digital technology can widen educational inequalities between urban and rural communities.
ex.zh: 获取数字技术的机会不均等，可能扩大城乡社区之间的教育差距。

tip: 奇数用odd，不用uneven；uneven强调不平或不均。

senses.en: not suitable or good enough for a particular purpose
not physically healthy or strong, often through lack of exercise

ex.en: The rusty bicycle was unfit for the long journey.
ex.zh: 那辆生锈的自行车不适合用来长途骑行。

ex.en: Poor maintenance can make public housing unfit for occupation, putting additional pressure on local authorities.
ex.zh: 维护不善可能使公共住房不宜居住，给地方政府带来额外压力。

tip: 常用unfit for sth或unfit to do sth。

senses.en: not fair or morally right

ex.en: It seemed unjust to blame her for everyone's mistakes.
ex.zh: 把大家的错误都归咎于她，似乎很不公平。

ex.en: An unjust legal system can weaken public trust and discourage citizens from seeking help through official channels.
ex.zh: 不公正的法律制度会削弱公众信任，并使公民不愿通过官方渠道寻求帮助。

tip: unjust强调违背公正原则；unfair使用范围更广。

senses.en: Done or working without receiving money.
Not yet paid or settled.

ex.en: She does unpaid work at the animal shelter every Saturday.
ex.zh: 她每周六都在动物收容所做无偿工作。

ex.en: Unpaid internships can disadvantage students who cannot afford to work without a regular income.
ex.zh: 无薪实习可能使那些无法承受没有固定收入的学生处于不利地位。

tip: unpaid work指无偿工作；unpaid bills指未付账单。

senses.en: Not fair, sensible, or willing to accept good reasons.
Greater than is fair or acceptable.

ex.en: It seems unreasonable to blame you for the weather.
ex.zh: 因为天气不好而责怪你，似乎很不讲理。

ex.en: Expecting employees to answer messages throughout their holidays places unreasonable demands on their time and harms wellbeing.
ex.zh: 要求员工整个假期都回复消息，是对其时间的过分索取，也会损害身心健康。

tip: 可形容人不讲理，也可形容要求或价格过分。

senses.zh: 不令人满意的；不合格的
senses.en: Not good enough to meet expectations or requirements.

ex.en: The repair was unsatisfactory, so I called the mechanic again.
ex.zh: 维修效果不理想，所以我又给修理工打了电话。

ex.en: Unsatisfactory housing conditions can negatively affect children's health and their ability to concentrate at school.
ex.zh: 不良的居住条件可能损害儿童健康，并影响他们在学校集中注意力的能力。

tip: 形容事物不够好；人的不满用dissatisfied。

senses.en: not right or appropriate for a particular person or purpose

ex.en: These thin shoes are unsuitable for walking through deep snow.
ex.zh: 这双薄鞋不适合在深雪中行走。

ex.en: Some traditional teaching methods are unsuitable for large classes because they offer limited opportunities for individual feedback.
ex.zh: 一些传统教学方法不适合大班教学，因为它们提供个别反馈的机会有限。

tip: 常用unsuitable for sb/sth，表示不适合某人或用途。

senses.en: not wanted or received with pleasure

ex.en: The loud music was an unwelcome interruption during dinner.
ex.zh: 晚餐时响起的吵闹音乐令人扫兴。

ex.en: For many residents, rising rents are an unwelcome consequence of rapid development in urban areas.
ex.zh: 对许多居民而言，租金上涨是城市快速发展带来的不受欢迎的后果。

tip: 可形容人、消息或变化；feel unwelcome指感到不受欢迎。

senses.en: not wanting or agreeing to do something

ex.en: He was unwilling to lend his new bicycle.
ex.zh: 他不愿意把自己的新自行车借出去。

ex.en: Some commuters are unwilling to cycle to work because busy roads lack safe lanes and secure bicycle parking.
ex.zh: 一些通勤者不愿骑车上班，因为繁忙的道路缺乏安全的车道和可靠的自行车停放设施。

tip: 常用be unwilling to do；不愿做不等于unable不能做。

senses.en: The way or amount that something is used.
The customary way words or phrases are used in language.

ex.en: My phone tracks my daily data usage automatically.
ex.zh: 我的手机会自动记录我每天的数据使用量。

ex.en: Installing efficient appliances can reduce household energy usage without requiring major changes to everyday routines.
ex.zh: 安装高效电器可以减少家庭能源使用量，而无需大幅改变日常习惯。

tip: usage重在使用量、使用方式或语言惯用法。

senses.en: Complete or total, used to emphasise something
To say something or make a sound with your voice

ex.en: The kitchen was in utter chaos after we baked.
ex.zh: 我们烘焙完后，厨房彻底乱成了一团。

ex.en: Without adequate planning, rapid urban expansion can result in utter confusion over land ownership and infrastructure responsibilities.
ex.zh: 如果缺乏充分规划，快速的城市扩张可能导致土地所有权与基础设施责任划分完全混乱。

tip: 形容词utter只放名词前；副词用utterly。

senses.en: A job or position available for someone to fill.
A room available for someone to stay in.

ex.en: The local library has a vacancy for an assistant.
ex.zh: 当地的图书馆有一个助理职位空缺。

ex.en: Despite rising unemployment, many employers report difficulty filling vacancies that require advanced technical skills.
ex.zh: 尽管失业率上升，许多雇主仍表示难以填补需要高级技术技能的职位空缺。

tip: 职位、客房空缺均可数；复数为vacancies。

senses.en: Giving a vaccine to help protect someone against disease

ex.en: The nurse asked me to relax before my vaccination.
ex.zh: 接种疫苗前，护士让我放松。

ex.en: Accessible vaccination programmes help prevent infectious diseases and reduce pressure on public healthcare services.
ex.zh: 便捷可及的疫苗接种计划有助于预防传染病，并减轻公共医疗服务的压力。

tip: 接种以预防某病用vaccination against。

senses.en: A gas formed when a liquid or solid changes state.

ex.en: Water vapour condensed into droplets on the cold window.
ex.zh: 水蒸气在冰冷的窗户上凝结成了水滴。

ex.en: As global temperatures rise, the atmosphere can hold more water vapour, which further strengthens the greenhouse effect.
ex.zh: 随着全球气温上升，大气能容纳更多水蒸气，从而进一步增强温室效应。

tip: 英式拼写为vapour，美式为vapor。

senses.en: Likely or able to change rather than remain the same.
A quantity or factor that can take different values.

ex.en: The weather here is too variable for outdoor plans.
ex.zh: 这里天气太多变，不好安排户外活动。

ex.en: Researchers must control other variables when investigating how class size affects students' progress in primary education.
ex.zh: 研究班级规模如何影响小学生的学习进步时，研究人员必须控制其他变量。

tip: 作形容词指可变的；作可数名词指变量。

senses.en: pointing straight up or down, perpendicular to a horizontal surface
a vertical line, direction, or position

ex.en: The curtains have vertical stripes that make the room look taller.
ex.zh: 窗帘上的竖条纹让房间显得更高。

ex.en: Vertical farming could help cities produce fresh vegetables locally while using less land than conventional agricultural methods.
ex.zh: 垂直农业可以帮助城市就地生产新鲜蔬菜，同时比传统农业方式占用更少的土地。

tip: vertical指竖直方向；horizontal指水平方向。

senses.en: Magnetic tape used to record moving images and sound.
To record moving images and sound onto magnetic tape.

ex.en: We found an old videotape of our family picnic.
ex.zh: 我们找到了一盘记录家庭野餐的旧录像带。

ex.en: Libraries can preserve recordings stored on videotape by converting them into digital formats for future generations.
ex.zh: 图书馆可以将录像带上的影像转成数字格式，为后代保存这些记录。

tip: 指磁带录像；现代数字录像通常用video或record。

senses.en: a particular way of thinking about an issue
a place offering a good view of surrounding scenery

ex.en: Hearing your story helped me understand your viewpoint.
ex.zh: 听了你的经历，我更能理解你的看法了。

ex.en: Considering an issue from another person's viewpoint can help communities resolve disagreements more effectively.
ex.zh: 从他人的角度考虑问题，可以帮助社区更有效地解决分歧。

tip: 表示“从某人的角度看”时，搭配 from。

senses.en: Related to volcanoes or produced by their activity.
Sudden and extremely powerful, especially when describing anger.

ex.en: We walked across dark volcanic rock near the coast.
ex.zh: 我们在海岸附近的深色火山岩上行走。

ex.en: Although volcanic eruptions threaten nearby settlements, the resulting soils can support highly productive agriculture over time.
ex.zh: 虽然火山喷发威胁附近的居民区，但其形成的土壤经过一段时间后可支撑高产农业。

tip: 通常作形容词；“火山岩”用volcanic rock。

senses.en: a unit used to measure power

ex.en: This small lamp uses only five watts of power.
ex.zh: 这盏小灯的功率只有五瓦。

ex.en: Comparing the watts required by different appliances helps consumers choose models that use less electricity.
ex.zh: 比较不同电器所需的瓦数，有助于消费者选择更省电的型号。

tip: 瓦特衡量功率；千瓦时衡量用电量。

senses.en: towards the west
moving or pointing towards the west

ex.en: We drove westward as the sun began to set.
ex.zh: 太阳开始落山时，我们驾车向西行驶。

ex.en: The westward expansion of the city has increased pressure on farmland and created demand for new infrastructure.
ex.zh: 城市向西扩张加大了农田面临的压力，也带来了对新基础设施的需求。

tip: westward可作形容词或副词；westwards只作副词。

senses.en: a business selling large quantities of goods mainly to retailers

ex.en: Our local wholesaler delivers fresh fruit to shops every morning.
ex.zh: 我们当地的批发商每天早上给商店配送新鲜水果。

ex.en: Small retailers often depend on a wholesaler to obtain goods at competitive prices.
ex.zh: 小型零售商往往依靠批发商以有竞争力的价格采购商品。

tip: wholesaler主要向商家批量供货，而非直接零售。

senses.en: a woman whose spouse has died and who has not remarried

ex.en: The widow next door invited us over for tea.
ex.zh: 住在隔壁的那位丧偶女士邀请我们去喝茶。

ex.en: A widow living alone may benefit from community programmes that offer companionship and practical support.
ex.zh: 独居的丧偶女性可能受益于提供陪伴和实际帮助的社区项目。

tip: widow指丧偶女性；丧偶男性用widower。

senses.en: having no value or practical use

ex.en: Without its missing parts, this old machine is worthless.
ex.zh: 缺了那些零件，这台旧机器就毫无用处。

ex.en: Digital skills can quickly become worthless if training focuses only on tools that are soon outdated.
ex.zh: 如果培训只关注很快就会过时的工具，数字技能可能迅速失去价值。

tip: worthless指无价值；priceless反而指极珍贵。

senses.en: A child or young person.

ex.en: A cheerful youngster helped me pick up the apples.
ex.zh: 一个开朗的孩子帮我捡起了那些苹果。

ex.en: Community sports programmes give youngsters opportunities to develop teamwork skills and build friendships outside school.
ex.zh: 社区体育项目让青少年有机会培养团队协作能力，并在校外建立友谊。

tip: 男女皆可指，语气较随意；正式写作可用young people。
